/* js/FXController.js */
import EventBus from './event-bus.js';
import { AppStore } from './store.js';
import { ReptileEngine } from './reptile-engine.js';
import { DragonEngine } from './dragon-engine.js';
import { CometEngine } from './comets.js';
import { MatrixEngine } from './matrix-engine.js';

export class FXController {
    constructor() {
        this.engines = {
            reptile: new ReptileEngine(),
            dragon: new DragonEngine(),
            comet: new CometEngine(),
            matrix: new MatrixEngine()
        };
    }

    init() {
        this.registerEventHandlers();
        this.engines.comet.startIdle();
        console.log('✨ [FXController] Графические движки инициализированы');
    }

    registerEventHandlers() {
        EventBus.on('CMD_CLEAR', () => {
            this.engines.reptile.stop(); 
            this.engines.dragon.stop(); 
            this.engines.comet.stopShower();
            this.engines.matrix.stop();
        });
        
        EventBus.on('CMD_LIZARD', () => { 
            this.engines.dragon.stop(); 
            this.engines.reptile.start(); 
        });
        
        EventBus.on('CMD_DRAGON', () => { 
            this.engines.reptile.stop(); 
            this.engines.dragon.start(); 
        });
        
        EventBus.on('CMD_COMET', () => this.engines.comet.triggerShower());
        
        EventBus.on('UI_CLICK_CLEAR', () => { 
            this.engines.reptile.stop(); 
            this.engines.dragon.stop(); 
        });
        
        EventBus.on('CMD_GOD', () => AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'FX_TOGGLE_GODMODE' }));
        EventBus.on('CMD_GODMODE', () => AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'FX_TOGGLE_GODMODE' }));

        // Синхронизация состояний из AppStore
        AppStore.subscribe((state, prevState) => {
            
            // 1. Управление паузой
            if (state.fx.isPaused !== prevState?.fx?.isPaused) {
                if (state.fx.isPaused) {
                    this.pauseAll();
                } else {
                    this.resumeAll(state.fx.mode);
                }
            }

            // 2. Управление режимами скролла и фонов (Если не на паузе)
            if (!state.fx.isPaused && state.fx.mode !== prevState?.fx?.mode) {
                this.applyFxMode(state.fx.mode, state.fx.isGodMode);
            }

            // 3. Управление режимом бога
            if (state.fx.isGodMode !== prevState?.fx?.isGodMode) {
                if (state.fx.isGodMode) {
                    if (!state.fx.isPaused) this.engines.matrix.start();
                    if (this.engines.matrix.curtain) this.engines.matrix.curtain.style.opacity = '0';
                    EventBus.emit('SYS_LOG', { type: 'system', tag: 'PROTOCOL', action: 'GOD_MODE', value: 'ACTIVATED', color: '#ffd700' });
                } else {
                    this.engines.matrix.stop();
                    EventBus.emit('SYS_LOG', { type: 'system', tag: 'PROTOCOL', action: 'GOD_MODE', value: 'DEACTIVATED', color: '#888' });
                }
                this.engines.matrix.isGodMode = state.fx.isGodMode;
            }
        });
    }

    pauseAll() {
        this.engines.reptile.stop();
        this.engines.dragon.stop();
        this.engines.comet.stopIdle();
        this.engines.comet.stopShower();
        this.engines.matrix.stop();
    }

    resumeAll(mode) {
        // Возобновляем только дефолтные фоны. Драконы вызываются вручную, поэтому не восстанавливаем.
        this.applyFxMode(mode, AppStore.getState().fx.isGodMode);
    }

    applyFxMode(mode, isGodMode) {
        document.body.classList.remove('state-no-comets', 'state-no-stars');
            
        if (mode === 0) {
            if (isGodMode) this.engines.matrix.start();
            this.engines.comet.startIdle();
        }
        else if (mode === 1) {
            document.body.classList.add('state-no-comets');
        }
        else if (mode === 2) {
            document.body.classList.add('state-no-stars');
        }
        else if (mode === 3) {
            document.body.classList.add('state-no-comets', 'state-no-stars');
            this.engines.matrix.stop();
            this.engines.comet.stopIdle();
        }
    }
}

import { AppConfig } from './config.js';
import EventBus from './event-bus.js';
import { Typewriter } from './utils/Typewriter.js';

export class HeroController {
    constructor() {
        this.els = {
            heroSection: document.querySelector('.hero-section-hud'),
            dataTicker: document.getElementById('data-ticker'),
            statusOuter: document.querySelector('.main-display-status'),
            statusInner: document.getElementById('live-status-container')
        };
        
        if (this.els.statusInner) {
            this.els.statusText = this.els.statusInner.querySelector('.status-text');
            this.els.statusDot = this.els.statusInner.querySelector('.status-indicator');
        }
        
        this.messages = AppConfig.texts.heroTicker || ["СИСТЕМЫ В НОРМЕ."];
        this.typewriter = null;

        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        if (!this.els.heroSection) return;
        
        if (this.els.dataTicker) {
            this.typewriter = new Typewriter(this.els.dataTicker);
            setTimeout(() => this.typewriter.loop(() => this.messages), 1000);
        }
        
        EventBus.on('TWITCH_DATA_UPDATED', (data) => this.updateDynamicData(data));
    }

    updateDynamicData(data) {
        const formatNum = (num) => num >= 1000 ? (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K' : num.toString();

        let newMessages = [
            "АНАЛИЗ СТАТИСТИКИ КАНАЛА...",
            `АГЕНТОВ В СЕТИ: ${formatNum(data.followers)}`,
            "ЛОЯЛЬНОСТЬ АУДИТОРИИ: 95%"
        ];

        if (data.isLive) {
            newMessages.push(`ПРЯМАЯ ТРАНСЛЯЦИЯ: ${data.game.toUpperCase()}`);
            newMessages.push(`ЗРИТЕЛЕЙ В ЭФИРЕ: ${formatNum(data.viewers)}`);
        } else {
            newMessages.push("СИСТЕМЫ В НОРМЕ.");
            newMessages.push("ОЖИДАНИЕ СИГНАЛА СТРИМЕРА.");
        }

        this.messages = newMessages;

        if (this.els.statusText && this.els.statusDot && this.els.statusOuter) {
            const isLive = data.isLive;
            // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: была опечатка в имени CSS-переменной
            const color = isLive ? '#ff4444' : 'var(--color-neon-pink)';
            const text = isLive ? 'В ЭФИРЕ' : 'СИСТЕМА АКТИВНА';
            
            this.els.statusText.textContent = text;
            this.els.statusText.style.color = color;
            
            this.els.statusDot.style.background = color;
            this.els.statusDot.style.boxShadow = `0 0 10px ${color}`;
            
            this.els.statusOuter.style.borderColor = color;
            this.els.statusOuter.style.boxShadow = `0 0 15px ${isLive ? 'rgba(255, 68, 68, 0.3)' : 'rgba(255, 45, 149, 0.2)'}`;
        }
    }
}

/* js/hub-controller.js */
import EventBus from './event-bus.js';
import { AppConfig } from './config.js';

export class HubController {
    constructor() {
        this.els = {
            playerContainer: document.getElementById('hub-player-container'),
            chatContainer: document.getElementById('hub-chat-container'),
            networkList: document.getElementById('hub-network-list')
        };

        if (this.els.playerContainer) this.init();
    }

    init() {
        console.log(`🛰️ [HubController] Инициализация Network Hub...`);
        this.embedTwitch();
        this.fetchNetworkStatus();
        setInterval(() => this.fetchNetworkStatus(), 120000);
    }

    embedTwitch() {
        let domain = window.location.hostname || "localhost";
        // Twitch не принимает пустой домен или 127.0.0.1 в качестве parent
        if (domain === "127.0.0.1" || domain === "") domain = "localhost";

        if (this.els.playerContainer) {
            // Добавлен autoplay=false чтобы плеер не падал при блокировках браузером
            this.els.playerContainer.innerHTML = `
                <iframe 
                    src="https://player.twitch.tv/?channel=${AppConfig.twitch.channel}&parent=${domain}&muted=true&autoplay=false" 
                    allowfullscreen="true"
                    class="twitch-iframe"
                    sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation">
                </iframe>
            `;
        }

        if (this.els.chatContainer) {
            this.els.chatContainer.innerHTML = `
                <iframe 
                    src="https://www.twitch.tv/embed/${AppConfig.twitch.channel}/chat?darkpopout&parent=${domain}"
                    class="twitch-iframe"
                    sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox">
                </iframe>
            `;
        }
    }

    async fetchNetworkStatus() {
        if (!this.els.networkList) return;
        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${AppConfig.api.ivrBaseUrl}?login=${AppConfig.twitch.allies}&t=${Date.now()}`);
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network Error');
            
            const users = await response.json();
            this.renderNetwork(users);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("❌ [HubController] Ошибка радара:", error);
            this.els.networkList.innerHTML = `<div class="network-error">ОШИБКА ПОДКЛЮЧЕНИЯ К СЕТИ</div>`;
        }
    }

    renderNetwork(users) {
        if (!users || users.length === 0) return;
        
        this.els.networkList.innerHTML = users.map(user => {
            const isLive = user.stream !== null;
            const gameName = isLive && user.stream.game ? user.stream.game.displayName : (user.lastBroadcast?.game?.displayName || 'Just Chatting');
            
            return `
                <a href="https://www.twitch.tv/${user.login}" target="_blank" class="ally-net-card ${isLive ? 'is-live' : ''}">
                    <img src="${user.logo}" class="ally-net-avatar" alt="${user.displayName}">
                    <div class="ally-net-info">
                        <div class="ally-net-name">${user.displayName}</div>
                        <div class="ally-net-game">${gameName}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="ally-net-status">${isLive ? 'LIVE' : 'ОФЛАЙН'}</div>
                </a>
            `;
        }).join('');
    }
}

/* js/library-controller.js */
import EventBus from './event-bus.js';
import { AppStore } from './store.js';
import { LibrarySearch } from './library/LibrarySearch.js';
import { LibraryUI } from './library/LibraryUI.js';
import { LibraryGrid } from './library/LibraryGrid.js';

/**
 * Полная библиотека. Тип, вкладка, сортировка, плотность и поиск
 * целиком берутся из адреса: #/library/movies?tab=dropped&mode=compact
 * Поиск делегирован единому компоненту SearchBox через адаптер LibrarySearch.
 */
export class LibraryController {
  constructor() {
    this.container = document.getElementById('route-library');
    if (!this.container) return;

    this.els = {
      pageWrapper: document.getElementById('library-page'),
      backBtn: document.getElementById('btn-library-back'),
      gridMain: document.getElementById('library-grid-main'),
      sortBtns: document.querySelectorAll('#library-sort-switcher .sort-btn'),
      typeBtns: document.querySelectorAll('#library-type-switcher .switcher-btn'),
      typeSwitcher: document.getElementById('library-type-switcher'),
      btnDetailed: document.getElementById('lib-grid-detailed'),
      btnCompact: document.getElementById('lib-grid-compact'),
      tabs: document.querySelectorAll('.lib-tab-btn'),
      labelCompleted: document.getElementById('label-completed'),
      labelPlaying: document.getElementById('label-playing')
    };

    const media = AppStore.getState().media;
    this.gridMode = media.gridMode || 'detailed';
    this.localSearchQuery = '';
    this.activeTab = 'completed';
    this.fadeTimer = null;

    this.search = new LibrarySearch(this);
    this.ui = new LibraryUI(this);
    this.grid = new LibraryGrid(this);

    this.bindEvents();
    console.log('📚 [Library] Контроллер инициализирован (URL-driven)');
  }

  mount() {
    const state = AppStore.getState();
    this.localSearchQuery = state.route.query.search || '';
    this.activeTab = state.route.query.tab || 'completed';

    this.search.setQuery(this.localSearchQuery);
    this.search.toggleSuggestions(false);

    this.applyGridMode(state.media.gridMode);
    this.ui.syncUIWithState();
    this.grid.renderGrid();
    console.log(`📚 [Library] Mount: ${state.media.type} / ${this.activeTab} / ${this.gridMode}`);
  }

  unmount() {
    clearTimeout(this.fadeTimer);
    this.fadeTimer = null;
    this.search.reset();
    if (this.els.gridMain) this.els.gridMain.style.opacity = '1';
    console.log('📚 [Library] Компонент размонтирован');
  }

  applyGridMode(mode) {
    this.gridMode = mode === 'compact' ? 'compact' : 'detailed';
    const compact = this.gridMode === 'compact';
    if (this.els.gridMain) this.els.gridMain.classList.toggle('compact-mode', compact);
    if (this.els.btnDetailed) {
      this.els.btnDetailed.classList.toggle('active', !compact);
      this.els.btnDetailed.setAttribute('aria-pressed', compact ? 'false' : 'true');
    }
    if (this.els.btnCompact) {
      this.els.btnCompact.classList.toggle('active', compact);
      this.els.btnCompact.setAttribute('aria-pressed', compact ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
  }

  fadeRender() {
    clearTimeout(this.fadeTimer);
    this.els.gridMain.style.opacity = '0';
    this.fadeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.fadeTimer = null;
      this.grid.renderGrid();
      this.els.gridMain.style.opacity = '1';
    }, 200);
  }

  bindEvents() {
    AppStore.subscribe((state, prevState) => {
      if (state.route.path !== '/library') return;
      const media = state.media;
      const prev = (prevState && prevState.media) || {};
      const tab = state.route.query.tab || 'completed';

      if (media.gridMode !== prev.gridMode) {
        this.applyGridMode(media.gridMode);
        this.ui.syncUIWithState();
        this.fadeRender();
        return;
      }

      let needsRender = false;
      if (media.type !== prev.type || media.sort !== prev.sort || media.sortDirection !== prev.sortDirection || tab !== this.activeTab) {
        this.activeTab = tab;
        needsRender = true;
      }

      const search = state.route.query.search || '';
      if (search !== this.localSearchQuery) {
        this.localSearchQuery = search;
        this.search.setQuery(search);
        needsRender = true;
      }

      if (needsRender) {
        this.search.toggleSuggestions(false);
        this.ui.syncUIWithState();
        this.grid.renderGrid();
      }
    });

    EventBus.on('MEDIA_STORE_LOADING', () => {
      if (AppStore.getState().route.path !== '/library') return;
      this.els.gridMain.innerHTML = '<div class="suggestion-empty" style="width:100%; padding:100px 20px; color: var(--color-neon-pink);"><i class="fas fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i> ЗАГРУЗКА БАЗЫ ДАННЫХ...</div>';
    });

    EventBus.on('MEDIA_STORE_LOADED', () => {
      if (AppStore.getState().route.path !== '/library') return;
      this.ui.syncUIWithState();
      this.grid.renderGrid();
    });
  }
}

/* js/matrix-engine.js */
import EventBus from './event-bus.js';
import { AppConfig } from './config.js';

const CHARS = "アァカサтанамāяāлавагазадабапаиикишичиниҳимиривигиджидзибипиуукусуцунуфумуююлугузубудзупуеекесеТЕНЕХЕМЕРЕВЕГЕЗЕДЕБЕПЕОокосотонохомоёёловогозодобоповуцн0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";

export class MatrixEngine {
    constructor() {
        this.canvas = null;
        this.ctx = null;
        this.curtain = null;
        
        this.drops = [];
        this.activeEasterEggs = {};
        
        this.rafId = null;
        this.lastDrawTime = 0;
        this.fps = 30;
        this.interval = 1000 / this.fps;
        
        this.isGodMode = false;
        
        this.onResize = this.onResize.bind(this);
    }

    start() {
        if (this.canvas) return;

        // 1. Динамическое создание элементов Canvas
        this.canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d');
        Object.assign(this.canvas.style, {
            position: 'fixed', top: '0', left: '0', width: '100%', height: '100%',
            zIndex: 'var(--z-matrix)', pointerEvents: 'none', opacity: '0.15'
        });
        document.body.appendChild(this.canvas);

        // 2. Динамическое создание Curtain (Шторки)
        this.curtain = document.createElement('div');
        Object.assign(this.curtain.style, {
            position: 'absolute', top: '0', left: '0', width: '100%', height: '100%',
            backgroundColor: '#050508', zIndex: 'calc(var(--z-matrix) + 5)', pointerEvents: 'none',
            transition: 'opacity 2s ease-in-out', opacity: '1'
        });
        document.body.appendChild(this.curtain);

        // 3. Биндинг событий
        window.addEventListener('resize', this.onResize);
        this.onResize();

        // 4. Запуск цикла
        this.lastDrawTime = performance.now();
        this.loop();
        
        console.log('🤖 [MatrixEngine] Запущен');
    }

    stop() {
        if (this.rafId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
            this.rafId = null;
        }
        if (this.canvas) {
            this.canvas.remove();
            this.canvas = null;
            this.ctx = null;
        }
        if (this.curtain) {
            this.curtain.remove();
            this.curtain = null;
        }
        window.removeEventListener('resize', this.onResize);
        console.log('🤖 [MatrixEngine] Деактивирован, ресурсы освобождены');
    }

    onResize() {
        if (!this.canvas) return;
        this.canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        this.canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        
        const columns = Math.floor(this.canvas.width / 16);
        this.drops = new Array(columns).fill(1);
    }

    loop() {
        if (!this.canvas) return;
        this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop());

        const now = performance.now();
        const delta = now - this.lastDrawTime;

        if (delta > this.interval) {
            this.draw();
            this.lastDrawTime = now - (delta % this.interval);
        }
    }

    draw() {
        if (!this.ctx || !this.canvas) return;

        const secretWords = AppConfig.texts.matrixWords || ["MATRIX"];

        this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 5, 8, 0.05)';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
        this.ctx.font = '14px monospace';

        for (let i = 0; i < this.drops.length; i++) {
            let text = "";
            
            if (this.activeEasterEggs[i]) {
                const egg = this.activeEasterEggs[i];
                text = egg.word[egg.charIndex]; 
                this.ctx.fillStyle = egg.color; 
                this.activeEasterEggs[i].charIndex++;
                if (this.activeEasterEggs[i].charIndex >= egg.word.length) delete this.activeEasterEggs[i];
            } 
            else if (Math.random() > 0.999) {
                const randomWord = secretWords[Math.floor(Math.random() * secretWords.length)];
                const colors = ['#ff2d95', '#ffffff', '#ffd700']; 
                const randomColor = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];

                this.activeEasterEggs[i] = { word: randomWord, charIndex: 0, color: randomColor };
                text = randomWord[0];
                this.ctx.fillStyle = randomColor;
                this.activeEasterEggs[i].charIndex++;
            }
            else {
                text = CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * CHARS.length));
                this.ctx.fillStyle = '#0F0'; 
            }

            this.ctx.fillText(text, i * 16, this.drops[i] * 16);

            if (this.drops[i] * 16 > this.canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
                this.drops[i] = 0;
                if (this.activeEasterEggs[i]) delete this.activeEasterEggs[i];
            }
            this.drops[i]++;
        }
    }

    toggleGodMode() {
        this.isGodMode = !this.isGodMode;
        if (this.isGodMode) {
            this.start();
            if (this.curtain) this.curtain.style.opacity = '0';
        } else {
            this.stop();
        }
        EventBus.emit('STATE_GODMODE_CHANGED', this.isGodMode);
    }
}

/* js/media-item-controller.js */
/*
 * Оркестратор страницы медиа-объекта.
 * Отвечает за соответствие URL <-> состояние страницы:
 *   #/item/{id}?part={subId}&slide={n}&v={youtubeId}&from=...&tab=...&page=...
 * Суб-состояние пишется через replace, чтобы не засорять историю браузера.
 */
import { AppStore } from './store.js';
import { AppRouter } from './router.js';
import { ItemNavigation } from './media-item/ItemNavigation.js';
import { ItemRenderer } from './media-item/ItemRenderer.js';
import { ItemPosters } from './media-item/ItemPosters.js';
import { ItemPlayer } from './media-item/ItemPlayer.js';
import { buildStack, SWAP_DURATION } from './media-item/item-utils.js';

/** Ищет объект по id / title, включая вложенные элементы коллекций. */
function resolveMediaItem(mediaList, needle) {
    if (!needle || !Array.isArray(mediaList)) return null;
    const key = String(needle);
    const lower = key.toLowerCase();

    let hit = mediaList.find(i => String(i.id) === key);
    if (hit) return { item: hit, forcedPart: null };

    hit = mediaList.find(i => String(i.title) === key);
    if (hit) return { item: hit, forcedPart: null };

    hit = mediaList.find(i => String(i.title || '').toLowerCase() === lower);
    if (hit) return { item: hit, forcedPart: null };

    // Прямая ссылка на часть коллекции: #/item/bendy-dark-revival
    for (const parent of mediaList) {
        if (parent.format !== 'collection' || !Array.isArray(parent.items)) continue;
        const sub = parent.items.find(s => String(s.id) === key || String(s.title) === key);
        if (sub) return { item: parent, forcedPart: String(sub.id) };
    }
    return null;
}

export class MediaItemController {
    constructor() {
        this.container = document.getElementById('route-media-item');
        if (!this.container) return;

        this.els = {
            page: document.getElementById('media-item-page'),
            layout: document.getElementById('item-layout'),
            backBtn: document.getElementById('btn-item-back'),
            bg: document.getElementById('item-cinematic-bg'),
            statusBadge: document.getElementById('item-status-badge'),
            posterWrapper: document.getElementById('item-poster-wrapper'),
            posterDots: document.getElementById('item-poster-dots'),
            ratingBox: document.getElementById('item-rating-box'),
            ratingVal: document.getElementById('item-rating-val'),
            segments: document.getElementById('item-segments'),
            barcodeContainer: document.getElementById('item-barcode-container'),
            sysId: document.getElementById('item-sys-id'),
            dataType: document.getElementById('item-datatype'),
            mainZone: document.getElementById('item-main-zone'),
            title: document.getElementById('item-title-text'),
            googleLink: document.getElementById('item-google-link'),
            desc: document.getElementById('item-desc-text'),
            videoZone: document.getElementById('item-video-zone'),
            iframe: document.getElementById('item-iframe'),
            playlistCol: document.getElementById('item-playlist-col'),
            playlistList: document.getElementById('item-playlist-list')
        };

        this.fallbackColor = '#ff2d95';
        this.currentStack = [];
        this.currentRouteId = null;
        this.currentItemId = null;
        this.currentPartKey = null;
        this.currentVideoId = null;
        this.isRendered = false;
        this.swapTimer = null;
        this.waitUnsub = null;
        this.pendingItemId = null;

        this.renderer = new ItemRenderer(this.els);
        this.navigation = new ItemNavigation(this.els.backBtn);

        this.posters = new ItemPosters(this.els.posterWrapper, this.els.posterDots, {
            onActiveColor: (color) => this.renderer.applyThemeColor(color),
            onSlideChange: (item, color, index) => this.handleSlideChange(item, color, index)
        });

        this.player = new ItemPlayer(this.els, {
            onThemeColor: (color) => this.renderer.applyThemeColor(color),
            onBackground: (url) => this.renderer.setBackground(url),
            onTitleChange: (title) => {
                this.renderer.setTitle(title);
                AppRouter.setDocumentTitle(title);
            },
            onVideoChange: (videoId) => this.handleVideoChange(videoId)
        });

        this.subscribeToStore();
        console.log('🎬 [ItemPage] Контроллер инициализирован (URL-driven sub-state)');
    }

    /* ==================== STORE ==================== */

    subscribeToStore() {
        AppStore.subscribe((state) => {
            if (state.route.path !== '/item') return;
            const id = state.route.params.id;
            if (!id) return;
            if (id !== this.currentRouteId) {
                this.mount(id);
                return;
            }
            this.syncSubState(state.route.query);
        });
    }

    waitForData(itemId) {
        this.pendingItemId = itemId;
        if (this.waitUnsub) return;
        console.log('🎬 [ItemPage] База ещё грузится, ожидаем:', itemId);
        this.waitUnsub = AppStore.subscribe((state) => {
            if (!state.data.isMediaLoaded) return;
            const target = this.pendingItemId;
            this.clearWaiter();
            if (state.route.path === '/item' && state.route.params.id === target) {
                this.mount(target);
            }
        });
    }

    clearWaiter() {
        if (this.waitUnsub) {
            this.waitUnsub();
            this.waitUnsub = null;
        }
        this.pendingItemId = null;
    }

    /* ==================== LIFECYCLE ==================== */

    mount(itemId) {
        if (!itemId) {
            console.warn('⚠️ [ItemPage] Пустой ID — возврат в базу.');
            this.redirectToArchive();
            return;
        }

        const state = AppStore.getState();

        if (!state.data.isMediaLoaded) {
            this.waitForData(itemId);
            return;
        }

        if (this.currentRouteId === itemId && this.isRendered) {
            this.syncSubState(state.route.query);
            return;
        }

        const resolved = resolveMediaItem(state.data.media, itemId);
        if (!resolved) {
            console.warn(`⚠️ [ItemPage] Объект "${itemId}" не найден. Мягкий редирект (replace).`);
            this.redirectToArchive();
            return;
        }

        this.renderPage(resolved.item, itemId, resolved.forcedPart);
    }

    redirectToArchive() {
        const type = AppStore.getState().media.type || 'games';
        // replace — иначе кнопка "Назад" зацикливается на битой ссылке.
        AppRouter.navigate('/archive', { type }, {}, { replace: true });
    }

    unmount() {
        this.cancelSwap();
        this.clearWaiter();
        this.posters.invalidate();
        this.player.stop();
        if (this.els.layout) this.els.layout.classList.remove('page-enter');
        this.currentStack = [];
        this.currentRouteId = null;
        this.currentItemId = null;
        this.currentPartKey = null;
        this.currentVideoId = null;
        this.isRendered = false;
        console.log('🎬 [ItemPage] Компонент размонтирован');
    }

    /* ==================== РЕНДЕР ==================== */

    renderPage(item, routeId, forcedPart) {
        try {
            this.isRendered = false;
            this.currentRouteId = routeId;
            this.currentItemId = item.id;
            this.cancelSwap();
            window.scrollTo(0, 0);

            /* Тип выводим из самого объекта: ссылка не зависит от того,
               в какой вкладке пользователь находился. Это же чинит
               кнопку "Назад" при холодном открытии карточки кино. */
            if (item.type && AppStore.getState().media.type !== item.type) {
                AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'MEDIA_SYNC_STATE', payload: { type: item.type } });
            }

            const query = AppStore.getState().route.query;

            this.fallbackColor = item.customColor || (item.format === 'youtube' ? '#ff0000' : '#ff2d95');
            this.els.page.classList.toggle('is-cinema', item.format === 'youtube');

            this.currentStack = buildStack(item);
            const startIndex = this.resolveStartIndex(query, forcedPart);
            const active = this.currentStack[startIndex] || this.currentStack[0];

            this.posters.render(this.currentStack, this.fallbackColor, startIndex);
            this.currentPartKey = this.partKeyFor(active, startIndex);

            this.renderer.applyDataFields(active, item.type, this.fallbackColor);

            this.player.render(active.videos, active.format || item.format, active.status, {
                initialVideoId: query.v || null
            });
            this.currentVideoId = this.player.getActiveVideoId();

            this.navigation.updateLabel(query.from || 'archive');
            AppRouter.setDocumentTitle(active.title || item.title);

            this.els.layout.classList.remove('page-enter');
            void this.els.layout.offsetWidth;
            this.els.layout.classList.add('page-enter');

            this.isRendered = true;
            this.syncUrlSubState();

            console.log(`🎬 [ItemPage] Отрендерен объект: ${item.id} (part index ${startIndex})`);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ [ItemPage] Ошибка рендера страницы:', error);
            this.isRendered = true;
        }
    }

    resolveStartIndex(query, forcedPart = null) {
        const partId = query.part || forcedPart;
        if (partId) {
            const idx = this.currentStack.findIndex(
                s => !s.isImageOnly && String(s.id) === String(partId)
            );
            if (idx >= 0) return idx;
            console.warn(`⚠️ [ItemPage] Часть "${partId}" не найдена в стеке — открываю первую.`);
        }
        if (query.slide !== undefined) {
            const n = parseInt(query.slide, 10);
            if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n < this.currentStack.length) return n;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    partKeyFor(stackItem, index) {
        if (!stackItem) return 'none';
        return stackItem.isImageOnly ? `slide:${index}` : `part:${stackItem.id}`;
    }

    /* ==================== URL <-> СОСТОЯНИЕ ==================== */

    /** Пишет part/slide/v в адрес, только если они реально отличаются. */
    syncUrlSubState() {
        if (!this.isRendered) return;
        const state = AppStore.getState();
        if (state.route.path !== '/item') return;
        if (state.route.params.id !== this.currentRouteId) return;

        const index = this.posters.getCurrentIndex();
        const active = this.currentStack[index];
        const patch = { part: null, slide: null, v: null };

        if (active && index > 0) {
            if (active.isImageOnly) patch.slide = String(index);
            else patch.part = String(active.id);
        }

        const firstVideo = this.player.getFirstVideoId();
        if (this.currentVideoId && this.currentVideoId !== firstVideo) {
            patch.v = this.currentVideoId;
        }

        const query = state.route.query;
        const changed = ['part', 'slide', 'v'].some(
            key => (query[key] || null) !== (patch[key] || null)
        );
        if (!changed) return;

        AppRouter.updateQuery(patch, { replace: true });
    }

    /** Применяет состояние из URL (кнопки браузера, вставка ссылки). */
    syncSubState(query) {
        if (!this.isRendered) return;

        const index = this.resolveStartIndex(query);
        const active = this.currentStack[index];
        const key = this.partKeyFor(active, index);

        if (key !== this.currentPartKey) {
            this.posters.goTo(index);
            return;
        }

        const target = query.v || this.player.getFirstVideoId();
        if (target && target !== this.currentVideoId) {
            this.player.selectByVideoId(target);
        }
    }

    /* ==================== СОБЫТИЯ ==================== */

    handleSlideChange(item, color, index) {
        this.currentPartKey = this.partKeyFor(item, index);

        if (!item.isImageOnly) {
            this.currentVideoId = null; // старый ролик относится к другой части
            this.swapToItem(item, color);
        } else {
            this.renderer.applyThemeColor(color);
            this.renderer.setBackground(item.overrideImage || item.image);
        }
        this.syncUrlSubState();
    }

    handleVideoChange(videoId) {
        this.currentVideoId = videoId || null;
        this.syncUrlSubState();
    }

    swapToItem(currentItem, color) {
        this.cancelSwap();
        this.els.mainZone.classList.add('is-swapping');

        this.swapTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.swapTimer = null;
            try {
                this.renderer.applyDataFields(currentItem, currentItem.type, color);

                const desiredVideo = AppStore.getState().route.query.v || null;
                this.player.render(currentItem.videos, currentItem.format, currentItem.status, {
                    initialVideoId: desiredVideo
                });
                this.currentVideoId = this.player.getActiveVideoId();

                AppRouter.setDocumentTitle(currentItem.title);
                this.els.mainZone.classList.remove('is-swapping');
                this.syncUrlSubState();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('❌ [ItemPage] Ошибка переключения части коллекции:', error);
                this.els.mainZone.classList.remove('is-swapping');
            }
        }, SWAP_DURATION);
    }

    cancelSwap() {
        if (this.swapTimer) {
            clearTimeout(this.swapTimer);
            this.swapTimer = null;
        }
        if (this.els.mainZone) this.els.mainZone.classList.remove('is-swapping');
    }
}

/* js/media-manager.js */
import { MediaStore } from './media-store.js';
import { CardFactory } from './archive/CardFactory.js';
import { LazyLoader } from './archive/LazyLoader.js';
import { SearchController } from './archive/SearchController.js';
import { FilterController } from './archive/FilterController.js';
import { GridManager } from './archive/GridManager.js';

export async function initMediaArchive() {
    try {
        console.log('📂 [MediaArchive] Инициализация модульной архитектуры...');
        
        const store = new MediaStore();
        
        // Лямбда для получения текущего режима сетки (detailed/compact)
        const getGridMode = () => gridManager ? gridManager.gridMode : 'detailed';
        
        const factory = new CardFactory(getGridMode);
        const lazyLoader = new LazyLoader(getGridMode);
        
        // GridManager теперь инициализирует внутри себя новый ArchivePagination
        const gridManager = new GridManager(store, factory, lazyLoader);
        
        new SearchController();
        new FilterController(gridManager);
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("❌ [MediaArchive] Критическая ошибка при инициализации:", error);
    }
}

================================================================================

/* js/media-store.js */
import { loadData } from './api.js';
import EventBus from './event-bus.js';
import { SearchEngine } from './services/SearchEngine.js';
import { getYouTubeId } from './utils.js';
import { AppStore } from './store.js';
import { createStableId } from './utils/ids.js';

export const STATUS_MAP = {
    'completed': 'ПРОЙДЕНО', 'watched': 'ПОСМОТРЕНО',
    'playing': 'В ПРОЦЕССЕ', 'watching': 'СМОТРИМ',
    'dropped': 'БРОШЕНО', 'on-hold': 'ПОД ВОПРОСОМ',
    'suggested': 'ПРЕДЛОЖКА'
};

const MEDIA_TYPES = ['games', 'movies'];

/**
 * ГИБРИДНОЕ ХРАНИЛИЩЕ МЕДИА
 * Оба манифеста (games + movies) грузятся ОДИН раз.
 * Переключение типа — это дешёвый выбор среза, а не перезагрузка.
 * Благодаря этому:
 *   - ссылка #/item/{id} работает для любого типа при холодной загрузке;
 *   - ID больше не пересоздаются при переключении вкладок;
 *   - мини-тирлист агента всегда находит постеры игр.
 */
export class MediaStore {
    constructor() {
        this.rawByType = { games: [], movies: [] };
        this.suggestions = [];
        this.allMedia = [];

        this.dataMain = [];
        this.dataSuggestions = [];
        this.filteredMain = [];
        this.filteredSuggestions = [];
        this.combinedData = [];
        this.filteredMainStandard = [];
        this.filteredSuggStandard = [];
        this.filteredYoutube = [];

        this.isLoaded = false;
        this.loadPromise = null;
        this.loadToken = 0;
        this.activeType = null;

        AppStore.subscribe((state, prevState) => {
            const curr = state.media;
            const prev = (prevState && prevState.media) || {};

            if (curr.type !== prev.type) {
                this.setActiveType(curr.type);
                return;
            }

            if (
                curr.searchQuery !== prev.searchQuery ||
                JSON.stringify(curr.filters) !== JSON.stringify(prev.filters) ||
                curr.sort !== prev.sort ||
                curr.sortDirection !== prev.sortDirection
            ) {
                if (!this.isLoaded) return;
                this.processData();
                EventBus.emit('MEDIA_STORE_UPDATED');
            }
        });

        this.setActiveType(AppStore.getState().media.type || 'games');
    }

    /* ==================== ЗАГРУЗКА ==================== */

    setActiveType(type) {
        const safeType = MEDIA_TYPES.includes(type) ? type : 'games';
        if (this.activeType === safeType && this.isLoaded) return;

        this.activeType = safeType;
        console.log(`📂 [MediaStore] Активный тип: ${safeType}`);

        if (!this.isLoaded) {
            this.ensureLoaded();
            return;
        }
        this.applyActiveType();
    }

    ensureLoaded() {
        if (this.loadPromise) return this.loadPromise;
        this.loadPromise = this.loadAll();
        return this.loadPromise;
    }

    async loadAll() {
        const token = ++this.loadToken;
        EventBus.emit('MEDIA_STORE_LOADING');
        console.log('📂 [MediaStore] Загрузка всех манифестов (games + movies + suggestions)...');

        try {
            const [games, movies, sugGames, sugMovies, sugYt] = await Promise.all([
                loadData('games.json', []),
                loadData('movies.json', []),
                loadData('suggestions-games.json', []),
                loadData('suggestions-movies.json', []),
                loadData('suggestions-youtube.json', [])
            ]);

            if (token !== this.loadToken) return;

            const used = new Set();
            this.rawByType.games = this.normalizeList(games, 'games', 'main', used, false);
            this.rawByType.movies = this.normalizeList(movies, 'movies', 'main', used, false);

            const pGames = this.normalizeList(sugGames, 'games', 'sug-games', used, true);
            const pMovies = this.normalizeList(sugMovies, 'movies', 'sug-movies', used, true);
            const pYt = this.normalizeList(sugYt, 'movies', 'yt', used, true);

            this.suggestions = [...pGames, ...pMovies, ...pYt];

            this.fastPreprocess(this.rawByType.games);
            this.fastPreprocess(this.rawByType.movies);
            this.fastPreprocess(this.suggestions);

            this.allMedia = [
                ...this.rawByType.games,
                ...this.rawByType.movies,
                ...this.suggestions
            ];

            this.isLoaded = true;
            AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'DATA_SET_MEDIA', payload: this.allMedia });
            console.log(`✅ [MediaStore] База загружена. Всего объектов: ${this.allMedia.length}`);

            this.applyActiveType();
            this.fetchMissingTitles(this.allMedia, token);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('❌ [MediaStore] Критическая ошибка загрузки базы:', error);
            EventBus.emit('SYS_LOG', {
                type: 'system', tag: 'DATABASE', action: 'ERROR',
                value: 'LOAD_FAILED', color: 'var(--color-danger-red)'
            });
            // Разблокируем ожидание, чтобы страницы не висели вечно.
            this.isLoaded = true;
            this.allMedia = [];
            AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'DATA_SET_MEDIA', payload: [] });
            this.applyActiveType();
        }
    }

    /** Проставляет стабильные ID, тип, формат и статус (рекурсивно для коллекций). */
    normalizeList(array, defaultType, prefix, used, isSuggestion) {
        if (!Array.isArray(array)) {
            console.warn(`⚠️ [MediaStore] Ожидался массив для "${prefix}", получен:`, typeof array);
            return [];
        }

        return array.map(raw => {
            const item = { ...(raw || {}) };
            const hasItems = Array.isArray(item.items) && item.items.length > 0;

            item.id = createStableId(item, prefix, used);
            item.type = item.type || defaultType;
            item.format = item.format || (hasItems ? 'collection' : (prefix === 'yt' ? 'youtube' : 'standard'));
            if (isSuggestion) item.status = 'suggested';

            if (hasItems) {
                item.items = item.items.map(subRaw => {
                    const sub = { ...(subRaw || {}) };
                    sub.id = createStableId(sub, 'sub', used);
                    sub.type = sub.type || item.type;
                    sub.format = sub.format || 'standard';
                    if (isSuggestion) sub.status = 'suggested';
                    return sub;
                });
            }
            return item;
        });
    }

    applyActiveType() {
        this.dataMain = this.rawByType[this.activeType] || [];
        // YouTube всегда доступен — у него отдельная страница.
        this.dataSuggestions = this.suggestions.filter(
            item => item.type === this.activeType || item.format === 'youtube'
        );
        this.processData();
        EventBus.emit('MEDIA_STORE_LOADED');
    }

    /* ==================== ПРЕПРОЦЕССИНГ ==================== */

    fastPreprocess(list) {
        for (const item of list) {
            if (item.format === 'collection') {
                this.normalizeCollection(item);
            }
            if (item.format === 'youtube' && Array.isArray(item.videos) && item.videos.length > 0) {
                const ytId = getYouTubeId(item.videos[0]);
                if (ytId && !item.image) {
                    item.image = `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${ytId}/hqdefault.jpg`;
                }
                if (!item.description) item.description = 'Описание от зрителя отсутствует.';
                if (!item.title) item.title = 'Установка связи...';
            }
        }
    }

    async fetchMissingTitles(list, token) {
        let hasChanges = false;
        const targets = list.filter(i => i.format === 'youtube' && i.title === 'Установка связи...');
        if (targets.length === 0) return;

        const tasks = targets.map(item => {
            const firstVid = item.videos[0];
            const oembed = `https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=${encodeURIComponent(firstVid)}&format=json`;
            return fetch(oembed)
                .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('oembed failed'); return r.json(); })
                .then(d => { if (d.title) { item.title = d.title; hasChanges = true; } })
                .catch(() => fetch(`https://noembed.com/embed?url=${encodeURIComponent(firstVid)}`)
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(d => { if (d.title) { item.title = d.title; hasChanges = true; } }))
                .catch(() => { item.title = 'Засекреченный видеофайл'; hasChanges = true; });
        });

        await Promise.allSettled(tasks);
        if (token !== this.loadToken) return;
        if (!hasChanges) return;

        AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'DATA_SET_MEDIA', payload: [...this.allMedia] });
        this.processData();
        EventBus.emit('MEDIA_STORE_SILENT_UPDATE');
        console.log('📂 [MediaStore] Названия YouTube-роликов обновлены.');
    }

    normalizeCollection(item) {
        if (!Array.isArray(item.items) || item.items.length === 0) return;
        const first = item.items[0];

        item.title = item.title || first.title;
        item.description = item.description || first.description;
        item.status = item.status || first.status;
        item.customColor = item.customColor || first.customColor;
        item.image = item.image || first.image;

        if (!item.images) {
            item.images = item.items.slice(0, 3).map(sub => sub.image).filter(Boolean);
        }
        if (item.rating === undefined) item.rating = first.rating || 0;

        const base = item.customColor || '#444455';
        item.stackColors = [
            base,
            (item.items[1] && item.items[1].customColor) || base,
            (item.items[2] && item.items[2].customColor) || base
        ];
    }

    /* ==================== ФИЛЬТРАЦИЯ / СОРТИРОВКА ==================== */

    processData() {
        const { searchQuery, filters, sort, sortDirection } = AppStore.getState().media;
        const isAllSelected = !filters || filters.length === 0;

        const filterFn = (item) => {
            let matchScore = 1;
            if (searchQuery && searchQuery.length > 0) {
                let textToSearch = `${item.title || ''} ${item.description || ''}`.toLowerCase();
                if (item.format === 'collection' && Array.isArray(item.items)) {
                    item.items.forEach(sub => {
                        textToSearch += ` ${sub.title || ''} ${sub.description || ''}`;
                    });
                }
                matchScore = SearchEngine.scoreItemForGrid(textToSearch, item.title, searchQuery);
            }
            item._matchScore = matchScore;
            if (searchQuery && searchQuery.length > 0 && matchScore === 0) return false;
            if (isAllSelected) return true;
            return filters.includes(item.status);
        };

        const filteredMain = this.dataMain.filter(filterFn);
        const filteredSuggestions = this.dataSuggestions.filter(filterFn);

        const dir = sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        const sortFn = (a, b) => {
            if (searchQuery && searchQuery.length > 0 && Math.abs((a._matchScore || 0) - (b._matchScore || 0)) > 0.1) {
                return (b._matchScore || 0) - (a._matchScore || 0);
            }
            if (sort === 'rating') return ((a.rating || 0) - (b.rating || 0)) * dir;
            return (a.title || '').localeCompare(b.title || '') * dir;
        };

        filteredMain.sort(sortFn);
        filteredSuggestions.sort(sortFn);

        this.filteredMain = filteredMain;
        this.filteredSuggestions = filteredSuggestions;
        this.combinedData = [...filteredMain, ...filteredSuggestions];
        this.filteredMainStandard = filteredMain.filter(i => i.format !== 'youtube');
        this.filteredSuggStandard = filteredSuggestions.filter(i => i.format !== 'youtube');
        this.filteredYoutube = [];
    }
}

import { AppStore } from './store.js';
import { AudioCore } from './audio-core.js';
import { AudioUI } from './audio-ui.js';
import { AudioVisualizer } from './audio-visualizer.js';

let audioCoreInstance = null;
let audioUIInstance = null;
let audioVisualizerInstance = null;
let initPromise = null;

export async function initMusicPlayer() {
    if (initPromise) return initPromise;

    initPromise = (async () => {
        console.log('🎧 [MusicPlayer] Инициализация модуля...');
        try {
            audioCoreInstance = new AudioCore();
            await audioCoreInstance.loadTracks();
            AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'AUDIO_LOAD_TRACKS', payload: audioCoreInstance.tracks });
            AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'AUDIO_SET_VOLUME', payload: audioCoreInstance.audio.volume });

            audioUIInstance = new AudioUI(audioCoreInstance);
            audioVisualizerInstance = new AudioVisualizer(audioCoreInstance);
            console.log(`🎧 [MusicPlayer] Готов. Треков: ${audioCoreInstance.tracks.length}`);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('🚨 [MusicPlayer] Ошибка инициализации:', error);
            initPromise = null;
        }
    })();

    return initPromise;
}

/**
 * Единственный вход в режим плеера: состояние живёт в Store,
 * UI реагирует подпиской. Прямой вызов toggleMode() без аргумента
 * ломал состояние — теперь такое невозможно.
 */
export function setMusicMode(isActive) {
    const current = AppStore.getState().audio.isMusicModeActive;
    const target = Boolean(isActive);
    if (current !== target) AppStore.dispatch({ type: 'AUDIO_TOGGLE_MODE' });
    return target;
}

export function toggleMusicMode(force) {
    const current = AppStore.getState().audio.isMusicModeActive;
    return setMusicMode(typeof force === 'boolean' ? force : !current);
}

export function getMusicCore() { return audioCoreInstance; }
export function getMusicUI() { return audioUIInstance; }
export function getMusicVisualizer() { return audioVisualizerInstance; }

/* js/reptile-engine.js */

const SQUAD_COLORS = ["#ff4444", "#39ff14", "#ffd700", "#007bff", "#ff2d95"];

class Segment {
    constructor(parent, size, angle, range, stiffness) {
        this.isSegment = true;
        this.parent = parent;
        if (typeof parent.children === "object") parent.children.push(this);
        this.children = [];
        this.size = size;
        this.relAngle = angle;
        this.defAngle = angle;
        this.absAngle = parent.absAngle + angle;
        this.range = range;
        this.stiffness = stiffness;
        this.updateRelative(false, true);
    }
    updateRelative(iter, flex) {
        this.relAngle = this.relAngle - 2 * Math.PI * Math.floor((this.relAngle - this.defAngle) / 2 / Math.PI + 1 / 2);
        if (flex) {
            this.relAngle = Math.min(this.defAngle + this.range / 2, Math.max(this.defAngle - this.range / 2, (this.relAngle - this.defAngle) / this.stiffness + this.defAngle));
        }
        this.absAngle = this.parent.absAngle + this.relAngle;
        this.x = this.parent.x + Math.cos(this.absAngle) * this.size;
        this.y = this.parent.y + Math.sin(this.absAngle) * this.size;
        if (iter) this.children.forEach(c => c.updateRelative(iter, flex));
    }
    draw(ctx, iter) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(this.parent.x, this.parent.y); ctx.lineTo(this.x, this.y); ctx.stroke();
        if (iter) this.children.forEach(c => c.draw(ctx, true));
    }
    follow(iter) {
        const x = this.parent.x, y = this.parent.y;
        const dist = Math.hypot(this.x - x, this.y - y);
        this.x = x + this.size * (this.x - x) / dist;
        this.y = y + this.size * (this.y - y) / dist;
        this.absAngle = Math.atan2(this.y - y, this.x - x);
        this.relAngle = this.absAngle - this.parent.absAngle;
        this.updateRelative(false, true);
        if (iter) this.children.forEach(c => c.follow(true));
    }
}

class LimbSystem {
    constructor(end, length, speed, creature) {
        this.end = end; this.length = Math.max(1, length); this.creature = creature; this.speed = speed;
        creature.systems.push(this);
        this.nodes = [];
        let node = end;
        for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            this.nodes.unshift(node); node = node.parent;
            if (!node.isSegment) { this.length = i + 1; break; }
        }
        this.hip = this.nodes[0].parent;
    }
    moveTo(x, y) {
        this.nodes[0].updateRelative(true, true);
        let dist = Math.hypot(x - this.end.x, y - this.end.y);
        let len = Math.max(0, dist - this.speed);
        for (let i = this.nodes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            let node = this.nodes[i];
            let ang = Math.atan2(node.y - y, node.x - x);
            node.x = x + len * Math.cos(ang); node.y = y + len * Math.sin(ang);
            x = node.x; y = node.y; len = node.size;
        }
        this.nodes.forEach(node => {
            node.absAngle = Math.atan2(node.y - node.parent.y, node.x - node.parent.x);
            node.relAngle = node.absAngle - node.parent.absAngle;
            node.children.forEach(childNode => {
                if (!this.nodes.includes(childNode)) childNode.updateRelative(true, false);
            });
        });
    }
    update(mouseX, mouseY) { this.moveTo(mouseX, mouseY); }
}

class LegSystem extends LimbSystem {
    constructor(end, length, speed, creature) { 
        super(end, length, speed, creature);
        this.goalX = end.x; this.goalY = end.y; this.step = 0; this.forwardness = 0;
        this.reach = 0.9 * Math.hypot(this.end.x - this.hip.x, this.end.y - this.hip.y);
        let relAngle = this.creature.absAngle - Math.atan2(this.end.y - this.hip.y, this.end.x - this.hip.x);
        relAngle -= 2 * Math.PI * Math.floor(relAngle / 2 / Math.PI + 1 / 2);
        this.swing = -relAngle + (2 * (relAngle < 0) - 1) * Math.PI / 2;
        this.swingOffset = this.creature.absAngle - this.hip.absAngle;
    }
    update(mouseX, mouseY) {
        this.moveTo(this.goalX, this.goalY);
        if (this.step === 0) {
            if (Math.hypot(this.end.x - this.goalX, this.end.y - this.goalY) > 1) {
                this.step = 1;
                this.goalX = this.hip.x + this.reach * Math.cos(this.swing + this.hip.absAngle + this.swingOffset) + (2 * Math.random() - 1) * this.reach / 2;
                this.goalY = this.hip.y + this.reach * Math.sin(this.swing + this.hip.absAngle + this.swingOffset) + (2 * Math.random() - 1) * this.reach / 2;
            }
        } else if (this.step === 1) {
            let theta = Math.atan2(this.end.y - this.hip.y, this.end.x - this.hip.x) - this.hip.absAngle;
            let forwardness2 = Math.hypot(this.end.x - this.hip.x, this.end.y - this.hip.y) * Math.cos(theta);
            let dF = this.forwardness - forwardness2;
            this.forwardness = forwardness2;
            if (dF * dF < 1) {
                this.step = 0;
                this.goalX = this.hip.x + (this.end.x - this.hip.x);
                this.goalY = this.hip.y + (this.end.y - this.hip.y);
            }
        }
    }
}

class Creature {
    constructor(x, y, angle, fAccel, fFric, fRes, fThresh, rAccel, rFric, rRes, rThresh) {
        this.x = x; this.y = y; this.absAngle = angle;
        this.fSpeed = 0; this.fAccel = fAccel; this.fFric = fFric; this.fRes = fRes; this.fThresh = fThresh;
        this.rSpeed = 0; this.rAccel = rAccel; this.rFric = rFric; this.rRes = rRes; this.rThresh = rThresh;
        this.children = []; this.systems = [];
    }
    follow(x, y, ctx) {
        let dist = Math.hypot(this.x - x, this.y - y);
        let angle = Math.atan2(y - this.y, x - this.x);
        let accel = this.fAccel;
        if (this.systems.length > 0) {
            let sum = this.systems.reduce((acc, sys) => acc + (sys.step === 0 ? 1 : 0), 0);
            accel *= sum / this.systems.length;
        }
        this.fSpeed += accel * (dist > this.fThresh);
        this.fSpeed *= 1 - this.fRes;
        this.speed = Math.max(0, this.fSpeed - this.fFric);
        
        let dif = this.absAngle - angle;
        dif -= 2 * Math.PI * Math.floor(dif / (2 * Math.PI) + 1 / 2);
        if (Math.abs(dif) > this.rThresh && dist > this.fThresh) {
            this.rSpeed -= this.rAccel * (2 * (dif > 0) - 1);
        }
        this.rSpeed *= 1 - this.rRes;
        if (Math.abs(this.rSpeed) > this.rFric) this.rSpeed -= this.rFric * (2 * (this.rSpeed > 0) - 1);
        else this.rSpeed = 0;
        
        this.absAngle += this.rSpeed;
        this.absAngle -= 2 * Math.PI * Math.floor(this.absAngle / (2 * Math.PI) + 1 / 2);
        this.x += this.speed * Math.cos(this.absAngle);
        this.y += this.speed * Math.sin(this.absAngle);
        
        this.absAngle += Math.PI;
        this.children.forEach(c => c.follow(true, true));
        this.systems.forEach(s => s.update(x, y));
        this.absAngle -= Math.PI;
        
        this.draw(ctx, true);
    }
    draw(ctx, iter) {
        const r = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, r, Math.PI / 4 + this.absAngle, 7 * Math.PI / 4 + this.absAngle);
        ctx.moveTo(this.x + r * Math.cos(7 * Math.PI / 4 + this.absAngle), this.y + r * Math.sin(7 * Math.PI / 4 + this.absAngle));
        ctx.lineTo(this.x + r * Math.cos(this.absAngle) * 1.414, this.y + r * Math.sin(this.absAngle) * 1.414);
        ctx.lineTo(this.x + r * Math.cos(Math.PI / 4 + this.absAngle), this.y + r * Math.sin(Math.PI / 4 + this.absAngle));
        ctx.stroke();
        if (iter) this.children.forEach(c => c.draw(ctx, true));
    }
}

// ООП Движок
export class ReptileEngine {
    constructor() {
        this.canvas = null;
        this.ctx = null;
        this.rafId = null;
        this.critter = null;
        
        this.mouse = { x: window.innerWidth / 2, y: window.innerHeight / 2 };
        
        // FPS Limiter
        this.lastTime = 0;
        this.fpsInterval = 1000 / 60; // Максимум 60 FPS

        this.onMouseMove = this.onMouseMove.bind(this);
        this.onResize = this.onResize.bind(this);
    }

    setupLizard(size, legs, tail) {
        const s = size;
        const critter = new Creature(window.innerWidth / 2, window.innerHeight / 2, 0, s * 9, s * 2, 0.45, 16, 0.4, 0.085, 0.5, 0.3);
        let spinal = critter;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            spinal = new Segment(spinal, s * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2 / 3, 1.1);
            for (let ii = -1; ii <= 1; ii += 2) {
                let node = new Segment(spinal, s * 3, ii, 0.1, 2);
                for (let iii = 0; iii < 3; iii++) node = new Segment(node, s * 0.1, -ii * 0.1, 0.1, 2);
            }
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < legs; i++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                for (let ii = 0; ii < 6; ii++) {
                    spinal = new Segment(spinal, s * 4, 0, 1.571, 1.5);
                    for (let iii = -1; iii <= 1; iii += 2) {
                        let node = new Segment(spinal, s * 3, iii * 1.571, 0.1, 1.5);
                        for (let iv = 0; iv < 3; iv++) node = new Segment(node, s * 3, -iii * 0.3, 0.1, 2);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (let ii = -1; ii <= 1; ii += 2) {
                let node = new Segment(spinal, s * 12, ii * 0.785, 0, 8); 
                node = new Segment(node, s * 16, -ii * 0.785, 6.28, 1); 
                node = new Segment(node, s * 16, ii * 1.571, 3.1415, 2); 
                for (let iii = 0; iii < 4; iii++) new Segment(node, s * 4, (iii / 3 - 0.5) * 1.571, 0.1, 4);
                new LegSystem(node, 3, s * 12, critter);
            }
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < tail; i++) {
            spinal = new Segment(spinal, s * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2 / 3, 1.1);
            for (let ii = -1; ii <= 1; ii += 2) {
                let node = new Segment(spinal, s * 3, ii, 0.1, 2);
                for (let iii = 0; iii < 3; iii++) node = new Segment(node, s * 3 * (tail - i) / tail, -ii * 0.1, 0.1, 2);
            }
        }
        return critter;
    }

    start() {
        if (this.canvas) this.stop();

        this.canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        document.body.appendChild(this.canvas);
        
        Object.assign(this.canvas.style, {
            position: "fixed", left: "0", top: "0",
            zIndex: "var(--z-system)", pointerEvents: "none", backgroundColor: "transparent"
        });
        
        this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext("2d");
        this.ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        this.onResize();

        const color = SQUAD_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SQUAD_COLORS.length)];
        this.ctx.strokeStyle = color;

        const legNum = Math.floor(1 + Math.random() * 8); 
        this.critter = this.setupLizard(8 / Math.sqrt(legNum), legNum, Math.floor(4 + Math.random() * legNum * 8));

        document.addEventListener("mousemove", this.onMouseMove);
        window.addEventListener("resize", this.onResize);

        this.lastTime = performance.now();
        console.log(`🦎 [ReptileEngine] Запущен. Цвет: ${color}. Лимит FPS: 60`);
        this.loop();
    }

    stop() {
        if (this.rafId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
            this.rafId = null;
        }
        if (this.canvas) {
            this.canvas.remove();
            this.canvas = null;
        }
        document.removeEventListener("mousemove", this.onMouseMove);
        window.removeEventListener("resize", this.onResize);
        console.log('🦎 [ReptileEngine] Остановлен');
    }

    onMouseMove(e) {
        this.mouse.x = e.clientX;
        this.mouse.y = e.clientY;
    }

    onResize() {
        if (!this.canvas) return;
        this.canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        this.canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }

    loop() {
        this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop());
        
        // --- FPS THROTTLE ---
        const now = performance.now();
        const elapsed = now - this.lastTime;

        if (elapsed < this.fpsInterval) return;
        this.lastTime = now - (elapsed % this.fpsInterval);

        // --- PHYSICS & DRAWING ---
        try {
            this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
            if (this.critter) this.critter.follow(this.mouse.x, this.mouse.y, this.ctx);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("🦎 [ReptileEngine] Ошибка в физическом цикле:", error);
            this.stop();
        }
    }
}

/* js/router.js */
import { AppStore } from './store.js';
import { AppConfig } from './config.js';

const MEDIA_TYPES = ['games', 'movies'];
const SORT_KEYS = ['name', 'rating'];
const SORT_DIRS = ['asc', 'desc'];
const GRID_MODES = ['detailed', 'compact'];
const LIBRARY_TABS = ['completed', 'playing', 'on-hold', 'dropped', 'suggested'];
const FILTER_STATUSES = ['completed', 'watched', 'playing', 'watching', 'on-hold', 'dropped', 'suggested'];
const ITEM_SOURCES = ['archive', 'library', 'youtube', 'tierlist', 'agents'];

/** Реестр маршрутов: единственный источник истины о структуре URL. */
const ROUTE_DEFS = {
    '/':         { param: null,   title: 'ХАБ' },
    '/archive':  { param: 'type', title: 'БАЗА ДАННЫХ', values: MEDIA_TYPES, fallback: 'games' },
    '/library':  { param: 'type', title: 'БИБЛИОТЕКА',  values: MEDIA_TYPES, fallback: 'games' },
    '/tierlist': { param: 'type', title: 'ТИРЛИСТ',     values: MEDIA_TYPES, fallback: 'games' },
    '/youtube':  { param: null,   title: 'YOUTUBE АРХИВ' },
    '/agents':   { param: 'id',   title: 'ДОСЬЕ АГЕНТА' },
    '/item':     { param: 'id',   title: 'КАРТОЧКА' }
};

/** Какие query-параметры вообще имеют смысл на каждом маршруте. */
const ALLOWED_QUERY = {
    '/':         [],
    '/archive':  ['search', 'filters', 'sort', 'sortDir', 'mode', 'page'],
    '/library':  ['search', 'filters', 'sort', 'sortDir', 'mode', 'tab'],
    '/youtube':  ['search'],
    '/tierlist': ['edit'],
    '/agents':   [],
    '/item':     ['from', 'tab', 'part', 'slide', 'v', 'page', 'agentId', 'edit']
};

/** Дефолты не пишутся в URL — адрес остаётся чистым. */
const QUERY_DEFAULTS = {
    sort: 'name',
    sortDir: 'asc',
    mode: 'detailed',
    tab: 'completed',
    page: '1',
    slide: '0'
};

function safeDecode(segment) {
    try {
        return decodeURIComponent(segment);
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`⚠️ [Router] Битый сегмент URL "${segment}":`, error.message);
        return segment;
    }
}

function sanitizeParam(key, value) {
    const raw = String(value);
    switch (key) {
        case 'sort':    return SORT_KEYS.includes(raw) ? raw : null;
        case 'sortDir': return SORT_DIRS.includes(raw) ? raw : null;
        case 'mode':    return GRID_MODES.includes(raw) ? raw : null;
        case 'tab':     return LIBRARY_TABS.includes(raw) ? raw : null;
        case 'from':    return ITEM_SOURCES.includes(raw) ? raw : null;
        case 'edit':    return (raw === '1' || raw === 'true') ? '1' : null;
        case 'page': {
            const n = parseInt(raw, 10);
            return (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) ? String(n) : null;
        }
        case 'slide': {
            const n = parseInt(raw, 10);
            return (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0) ? String(n) : null;
        }
        case 'filters': {
            const list = raw.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => FILTER_STATUSES.includes(s));
            return list.length ? Array.from(new Set(list)).join(',') : null;
        }
        case 'search': {
            const trimmed = raw.trim().slice(0, 120);
            return trimmed.length ? trimmed : null;
        }
        case 'part':
        case 'v':
        case 'agentId': {
            const trimmed = raw.trim().slice(0, 120);
            return trimmed.length ? trimmed : null;
        }
        default: return null;
    }
}

class Router {
    constructor() {
        this.isInitialized = false;
        this.customTitle = null;
        this.onHashChange = () => this.handleHashChange();
    }

    init() {
        if (this.isInitialized) return;
        window.addEventListener('hashchange', this.onHashChange);
        this.isInitialized = true;

        const current = window.location.hash.slice(1);
        if (!current || current === '/') {
            // replace — чтобы не плодить лишнюю запись в истории на старте
            this.writeHash('/', { replace: true });
        } else {
            this.handleHashChange();
        }
        console.log('🧭 [Router] Инициализирован (канонические URL + атомарный ROUTE_SYNC)');
    }

    /* ============================ ПАРСИНГ ============================ */

    parseHash(hash) {
        const clean = String(hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
        const [pathPart = '', queryPart = ''] = clean.split('?');

        const rawQuery = {};
        if (queryPart) {
            try {
                const params = new URLSearchParams(queryPart);
                params.forEach((value, key) => { rawQuery[key] = value; });
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('⚠️ [Router] Не удалось разобрать query:', error.message);
            }
        }

        const segments = pathPart.split('/').filter(s => s.length > 0).map(safeDecode);
        const path = segments.length ? `/${segments[0]}` : '/';
        const def = ROUTE_DEFS[path];

        if (!def) {
            return { path, params: {}, query: {}, raw: clean, unknown: true };
        }

        const params = {};
        if (def.param && segments[1]) params[def.param] = segments[1];
        if (segments.length > 2) {
            console.warn(`⚠️ [Router] Лишние сегменты в "${clean}" проигнорированы.`);
        }

        return { path, params, query: this.normalizeQuery(path, rawQuery), raw: clean, unknown: false };
    }

    normalizeQuery(path, rawQuery) {
        const allowed = ALLOWED_QUERY[path] || [];
        const result = {};
        allowed.forEach(key => {
            const value = rawQuery[key];
            if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return;
            const clean = sanitizeParam(key, value);
            if (clean === null || clean === undefined || clean === '') return;
            if (QUERY_DEFAULTS[key] !== undefined && String(clean) === QUERY_DEFAULTS[key]) return;
            result[key] = String(clean);
        });
        return result;
    }

    /* ============================ СБОРКА ============================ */

    buildHash(path, params = {}, query = {}) {
        const def = ROUTE_DEFS[path] || ROUTE_DEFS['/'];
        const safePath = ROUTE_DEFS[path] ? path : '/';
        let hash = safePath;

        if (def.param) {
            const value = params[def.param];
            if (value !== undefined && value !== null && String(value).trim() !== '') {
                hash += '/' + encodeURIComponent(String(value).trim());
            }
        }

        const cleanQuery = this.normalizeQuery(safePath, query);
        const searchParams = new URLSearchParams();
        Object.keys(cleanQuery).sort().forEach(key => searchParams.append(key, cleanQuery[key]));
        const queryString = searchParams.toString();
        if (queryString) hash += `?${queryString}`;

        return hash;
    }

    /** Приводит распарсенный маршрут к каноническому виду. */
    resolveCanonical(parsed) {
        const state = AppStore.getState();

        if (parsed.unknown) {
            console.warn(`⚠️ [Router] Неизвестный маршрут "${parsed.raw}" -> возврат на хаб.`);
            return { path: '/', params: {}, query: {} };
        }

        const def = ROUTE_DEFS[parsed.path];
        const params = { ...parsed.params };

        if (def.param === 'type') {
            const type = params.type;
            if (!MEDIA_TYPES.includes(type)) {
                // Тип не указан/битый -> берём текущий контекст, чтобы не терять состояние
                params.type = MEDIA_TYPES.includes(state.media.type) ? state.media.type : def.fallback;
            }
        }

        if (parsed.path === '/item' && !params.id) {
            console.warn('⚠️ [Router] /item без ID -> возврат в базу.');
            return { path: '/archive', params: { type: state.media.type || 'games' }, query: {} };
        }

        return { path: parsed.path, params, query: parsed.query };
    }

    /* ============================ ПРИМЕНЕНИЕ ============================ */

    handleHashChange() {
        try {
            const rawHash = window.location.hash.slice(1) || '/';
            const parsed = this.parseHash(rawHash);
            const canonical = this.resolveCanonical(parsed);
            const canonicalHash = this.buildHash(canonical.path, canonical.params, canonical.query);

            if (canonicalHash !== rawHash) {
                console.log(`🧭 [Router] Канонизация: "${rawHash}" -> "${canonicalHash}"`);
                this.writeHash(canonicalHash, { replace: true });
                return;
            }

            this.applyRoute(canonical, canonicalHash);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('🚨 [Router] Ошибка обработки маршрута:', error);
        }
    }

    /** Какой срез media синхронизируем на этом маршруте (null = не трогаем). */
    buildMediaPatch(route) {
        const { path, params, query } = route;

        if (path === '/archive' || path === '/library') {
            return {
                type: params.type,
                searchQuery: query.search || '',
                filters: query.filters ? query.filters.split(',') : [],
                sort: query.sort || 'name',
                sortDirection: query.sortDir || 'asc',
                gridMode: query.mode || 'detailed',
                currentPage: path === '/archive' ? parseInt(query.page || '1', 10) : 1
            };
        }
        if (path === '/tierlist') return { type: params.type };
        if (path === '/youtube') return { searchQuery: query.search || '' };
        return null;
    }

    applyRoute(route, raw) {
        const state = AppStore.getState();
        const mediaPatch = this.buildMediaPatch(route);

        const sameRoute =
            state.route.raw === raw &&
            state.route.path === route.path &&
            JSON.stringify(state.route.params) === JSON.stringify(route.params) &&
            JSON.stringify(state.route.query) === JSON.stringify(route.query);

        const sameMedia = !mediaPatch || Object.keys(mediaPatch).every(key =>
            JSON.stringify(state.media[key]) === JSON.stringify(mediaPatch[key])
        );

        this.customTitle = null;
        this.updateDocumentTitle(route);

        if (sameRoute && sameMedia) {
            console.log(`🧭 [Router] Маршрут не изменился (${raw}) — диспатч пропущен.`);
            return;
        }

        console.log(`🧭 [Router] Маршрут применён: ${raw}`, { params: route.params, query: route.query });

        // ЕДИНЫЙ АТОМАРНЫЙ ДИСПАТЧ: route и media обновляются вместе.
        AppStore.dispatch({
            type: 'ROUTE_SYNC',
            payload: {
                route: { path: route.path, params: route.params, query: route.query, raw },
                media: mediaPatch
            }
        });
    }

    updateDocumentTitle(route) {
        const base = (AppConfig.identity && AppConfig.identity.pageTitle) || 'TETLA_OS';
        if (this.customTitle) {
            document.title = `${this.customTitle} — ${base}`;
            return;
        }
        const def = ROUTE_DEFS[route.path];
        if (!def || route.path === '/') {
            document.title = base;
            return;
        }
        let label = def.title;
        if (route.path === '/item' && route.params.id) label = route.params.id;
        if (route.path === '/agents' && route.params.id) label = route.params.id;
        if (def.param === 'type' && route.params.type) {
            label += ` / ${route.params.type === 'movies' ? 'КИНО' : 'ИГРЫ'}`;
        }
        document.title = `${label} — ${base}`;
    }

    /** Позволяет странице подставить человекочитаемый заголовок вкладки. */
    setDocumentTitle(text) {
        this.customTitle = text ? String(text) : null;
        this.updateDocumentTitle(AppStore.getState().route);
    }

    /* ============================ НАВИГАЦИЯ ============================ */

    writeHash(hash, options = {}) {
        const target = `#${hash}`;
        const replace = !!options.replace;

        if (window.location.hash === target || (!window.location.hash && hash === '/')) {
            this.handleHashChange();
            return;
        }

        if (replace) {
            let replaced = false;
            try {
                const url = `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${target}`;
                window.history.replaceState(null, '', url);
                replaced = true;
            } catch (error) {
                // file:// может запрещать replaceState — падаем на location.replace
                console.warn('⚠️ [Router] replaceState недоступен, использую location.replace:', error.message);
            }
            if (replaced) {
                this.handleHashChange();
            } else {
                window.location.replace(target);
            }
            return;
        }

        window.location.hash = target;
    }

    navigate(path, params = {}, query = {}, options = {}) {
        try {
            const hash = this.buildHash(path, params, query);
            this.writeHash(hash, options);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('🚨 [Router] Ошибка навигации:', error);
        }
    }

    updateQuery(patch = {}, options = {}) {
        const route = AppStore.getState().route;
        const merged = { ...route.query, ...patch };
        Object.keys(merged).forEach(key => {
            if (merged[key] === null || merged[key] === undefined || merged[key] === '') delete merged[key];
        });
        this.navigate(route.path, route.params, merged, options);
    }

    /** Куда возвращать «домой», чтобы URL не врал про активный тип базы. */
    getHomeTarget() {
        const type = AppStore.getState().media.type;
        if (type === 'movies') return { path: '/archive', params: { type: 'movies' } };
        return { path: '/', params: {} };
    }

    getCurrent() {
        return AppStore.getState().route;
    }
}

export const AppRouter = new Router();

/* js/schedule.js */
import { loadData } from './api.js';

export class ScheduleManager {
    constructor() {
        this.container = document.getElementById('schedule-container');
    }

    // ИСПРАВЛЕНО: Теперь 100% распознает дни независимо от того, написано полное слово или сокращение
    getDayIndex(dayStr) {
        const day = (dayStr || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        
        if (day.includes("воскресен") || day === "вс") return 0;
        if (day.includes("понедельник") || day === "пн") return 1;
        if (day.includes("вторник") || day === "вт") return 2;
        if (day.includes("сред") || day === "ср") return 3;
        if (day.includes("четверг") || day === "чт") return 4;
        if (day.includes("пятниц") || day === "пт") return 5;
        if (day.includes("суббот") || day === "сб") return 6;
        
        return 99; // Неизвестный день
    }

    async init() {
        if (!this.container) return;

        try {
            const data = await loadData('schedule.json', { schedule: [] });
            const segments = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.schedule || []);

            if (segments.length === 0) {
                this.container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="schedule-empty">
                        <i class="fas fa-calendar-times" style="font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 10px; color: #444;"></i>
                        <br><span>БАЗА ПУСТА</span>
                    </div>`;
                return;
            }

            // Получаем текущий день недели от системы (0 - Воскресенье, 1 - Понедельник...)
            const currentDayIndex = new Date().getDay(); 

            this.container.innerHTML = segments.map(segment => {
                const dayStr = segment.day || "ТБА";
                const timeStr = segment.time || "--:--";
                const gameName = segment.game || "Секретная миссия";
                const streamTitle = segment.description || "";
                
                // Проверяем, совпадает ли день из JSON с сегодняшним днем
                const isToday = this.getDayIndex(dayStr) === currentDayIndex;

                let cardClass = 'sched-card';
                if (isToday) cardClass += ' is-today';
                else if (segment.highlighted) cardClass += ' is-highlighted';

                return `
                <div class="${cardClass}">
                    <div class="sched-indicator"><div class="sched-dot"></div></div>
                    <div class="sched-content">
                        <div class="sched-game">${gameName}</div>
                        ${streamTitle ? `<div class="sched-desc">${streamTitle}</div>` : ''}
                    </div>
                    <div class="sched-datetime">
                        <div class="sched-day">${dayStr.toUpperCase()}</div>
                        <div class="sched-time"><i class="far fa-clock"></i> ${timeStr}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            }).join('');
            
        } catch (error) {
            this.container.innerHTML = '<div class="network-error">ОШИБКА БАЗЫ ДАННЫХ</div>';
        }
    }
}
