/* js/tierlist/TierlistBoard.js */

export class TierlistBoard {
    constructor(controller) {
        this.ctrl = controller;
        this.boardEl = document.getElementById('tier-board');
        this.setupAddButton();
    }

    renderBoard() {
        this.boardEl.innerHTML = '';
        
        this.ctrl.tiers.forEach(tier => {
            this.createRow(tier);
        });

        if (this.ctrl.isEditMode) {
            this.ctrl.dragDrop.setupDropzone(this.ctrl.poolEl);
        }
    }

    createRow(tier) {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'tier-row';
        row.dataset.id = tier.id;
        row.draggable = this.ctrl.isEditMode; 
        row.style.setProperty('--tier-color', tier.color);
        
        const contentAttr = this.ctrl.isEditMode ? 'contenteditable="true"' : 'contenteditable="false"';

        row.innerHTML = `
            <div class="tier-label-container">
                <div class="drag-grip no-capture edit-only" title="Перетащить категорию"><i class="fas fa-grip-vertical"></i></div>
                <div class="tier-label" ${contentAttr} spellcheck="false">${tier.name}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="tier-content dropzone" data-zone="${tier.id}"></div>
            
            <div class="row-settings no-capture edit-only">
                <div class="color-picker-wrapper" title="Цвет категории">
                    <div class="color-preview"></div>
                    <input type="color" value="${tier.color}">
                </div>
                <button class="row-btn delete" title="Удалить категорию"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt"></i></button>
            </div>
        `;

        if (this.ctrl.isEditMode) {
            this.bindRowControls(row, tier);
            this.ctrl.dragDrop.bindRowDragEvents(row);
            this.ctrl.dragDrop.setupDropzone(row.querySelector('.tier-content'));
        }
        
        this.boardEl.appendChild(row);
    }

    bindRowControls(row, tier) {
        const label = row.querySelector('.tier-label');
        label.addEventListener('blur', () => {
            tier.name = label.textContent.trim() || '???';
            this.syncTiersFromDOM();
            this.ctrl.saveState();
        });

        const colorInput = row.querySelector('input[type="color"]');
        colorInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            tier.color = e.target.value;
            row.style.setProperty('--tier-color', tier.color);
            this.syncTiersFromDOM();
            this.ctrl.saveState();
        });

        row.querySelector('.delete').addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (confirm(`Удалить категорию "${tier.name}"? Карточки вернутся в базу.`)) {
                const items = Array.from(row.querySelector('.tier-content').children);
                items.forEach(card => this.ctrl.poolEl.appendChild(card));
                row.remove();
                this.syncTiersFromDOM();
                this.ctrl.saveState();
                this.ctrl.updateCounter();
            }
        });
    }

    syncTiersFromDOM() {
        const newTiers = [];
        this.boardEl.querySelectorAll('.tier-row').forEach(row => {
            const id = row.dataset.id;
            const name = row.querySelector('.tier-label').textContent.trim() || '???';
            const color = row.querySelector('input[type="color"]').value;
            newTiers.push({ id, name, color });
        });
        this.ctrl.tiers = newTiers;
    }

    setupAddButton() {
        document.getElementById('btn-add-row').addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode) return;
            const newId = 'tier_' + Date.now().toString(36);
            const newTier = { id: newId, color: '#888888', name: 'NEW' };
            
            this.ctrl.tiers.push(newTier);
            this.createRow(newTier);
            this.ctrl.saveState();
        });
    }
}

/* js/tierlist/TierlistController.js */
import { loadData } from '../api.js';
import EventBus from '../event-bus.js';
import { AppStore } from '../store.js';
import { AppRouter } from '../router.js';
import { TierlistBoard } from './TierlistBoard.js';
import { TierlistDragDrop } from './TierlistDragDrop.js';
import { TierlistSearch } from './TierlistSearch.js';
import { TierlistExporter } from './TierlistExporter.js';

export const DEFAULT_TIERS = [
  { id: 'tier_S', color: '#ff2d95', name: 'S' },
  { id: 'tier_A', color: '#ff8c00', name: 'A' },
  { id: 'tier_B', color: '#ffd700', name: 'B' },
  { id: 'tier_C', color: '#39ff14', name: 'C' },
  { id: 'tier_D', color: '#00ccff', name: 'D' },
  { id: 'tier_TRASH', color: '#555555', name: 'TRASH' }
];

function escapeAttr(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

/**
 * Тирлист, управляемый адресом:
 *   #/tierlist/games        — просмотр
 *   #/tierlist/movies?edit=1 — редактирование
 * Категория и режим больше не живут в приватных полях контроллера.
 */
export class TierlistController {
  constructor() {
    this.container = document.getElementById('tierlist-app');
    if (!this.container) return;

    this.poolEl = document.getElementById('tier-pool');
    this.counterEl = document.getElementById('pool-counter');
    this.btnGames = document.getElementById('btn-load-games');
    this.btnMovies = document.getElementById('btn-load-movies');

    this.currentMode = 'games';
    this.dataBank = [];
    this.tiers = [];
    this.isEditMode = false;
    this.loadToken = 0;
    this.loadedKey = null;

    this.board = new TierlistBoard(this);
    this.dragDrop = new TierlistDragDrop(this);
    this.search = new TierlistSearch(this);
    this.exporter = new TierlistExporter(this);

    this.setupButtons();
    this.subscribeToStore();
    this.applyModeClasses();
    console.log('📋 [Tierlist] Контроллер инициализирован (URL-driven)');
  }

  /* ==================== LIFECYCLE ==================== */

  mount() {
    const route = AppStore.getState().route;
    this.ensureLoaded(this.resolveType(route), route.query.edit === '1');
    console.log(`📋 [Tierlist] Mount: ${this.currentMode} / ${this.isEditMode ? 'EDIT' : 'VIEW'}`);
  }

  unmount() {
    this.loadToken++;
    this.loadedKey = null;
    this.exporter.cleanup();
    this.search.reset();
    console.log('📋 [Tierlist] Компонент размонтирован');
  }

  resolveType(route) {
    if (route.params && (route.params.type === 'games' || route.params.type === 'movies')) return route.params.type;
    return AppStore.getState().media.type === 'movies' ? 'movies' : 'games';
  }

  subscribeToStore() {
    AppStore.subscribe((state) => {
      if (state.route.path !== '/tierlist') return;
      this.ensureLoaded(this.resolveType(state.route), state.route.query.edit === '1');
    });
  }

  ensureLoaded(type, edit) {
    const key = `${type}|${edit ? '1' : '0'}`;
    if (this.loadedKey === key) return;
    this.loadedKey = key;
    this.isEditMode = edit;
    this.applyModeClasses();
    this.loadCategory(type);
  }

  applyModeClasses() {
    this.container.classList.toggle('edit-mode', this.isEditMode);
    this.container.classList.toggle('view-mode', !this.isEditMode);
  }

  /* ==================== ДАННЫЕ ==================== */

  async loadCategory(type) {
    const token = ++this.loadToken;
    this.currentMode = type;
    if (this.btnGames) this.btnGames.classList.toggle('active', type === 'games');
    if (this.btnMovies) this.btnMovies.classList.toggle('active', type === 'movies');
    this.poolEl.innerHTML = '<div class="pool-loading"><i class="fas fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i> СКАНИРОВАНИЕ БАЗЫ...</div>';
    this.search.toggleSuggestions(false);

    try {
      const endpoint = type === 'games' ? 'games.json' : 'movies.json';
      const rawData = await loadData(endpoint, []);
      if (token !== this.loadToken) return;

      this.dataBank = [];
      (Array.isArray(rawData) ? rawData : []).forEach(item => {
        if (item.format === 'collection' && Array.isArray(item.items)) {
          item.items.forEach(sub => this.dataBank.push(sub));
        } else if (item.format !== 'youtube') {
          this.dataBank.push(item);
        }
      });

      if (this.isEditMode) await this.renderEditState(type, token);
      else await this.renderStaticState(type, token);
      if (token !== this.loadToken) return;

      this.dragDrop.bindCardEvents();
      AppRouter.setDocumentTitle(`ТИРЛИСТ / ${type === 'movies' ? 'КИНО' : 'ИГРЫ'}`);
      console.log(`📋 [Tierlist] Категория "${type}" отрисована. Объектов: ${this.dataBank.length}`);
    } catch (error) {
      if (token !== this.loadToken) return;
      console.error('🚨 [Tierlist] Ошибка загрузки категории:', error);
      this.poolEl.innerHTML = '<div class="pool-loading">ОШИБКА ЗАГРУЗКИ БАЗЫ</div>';
      this.tiers = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_TIERS));
      this.board.renderBoard();
    }
  }

  findBankItem(title) {
    return this.dataBank.find(i => i.title === title) || null;
  }

  cardHtml(item, draggable) {
    const img = item.image || (Array.isArray(item.images) ? item.images[0] : '');
    const title = escapeAttr(item.title);
    const imgTag = img
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttr(img)}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy">`
      : '<div style="width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--color-bg-medium);color:var(--color-text-muted);font-family:var(--font-header);">?</div>';
    return `<div class="t-card" draggable="${draggable ? 'true' : 'false'}" data-title="${title}" data-id="${title}">${imgTag}</div>`;
  }

  async renderStaticState(type, token) {
    const staticFile = type === 'games' ? 'tierlist-static-games.json' : 'tierlist-static-movies.json';
    const staticData = await loadData(staticFile, null);
    if (token !== this.loadToken) return;

    this.tiers = (staticData && Array.isArray(staticData.tiers) && staticData.tiers.length > 0)
      ? staticData.tiers.map(t => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name, color: t.color, items: t.items || [] }))
      : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_TIERS));

    this.board.renderBoard();
    this.poolEl.innerHTML = '';

    let placed = 0;
    this.tiers.forEach(tier => {
      const zone = this.board.boardEl.querySelector(`.tier-content[data-zone="${tier.id}"]`);
      if (!zone || !Array.isArray(tier.items)) return;
      tier.items.forEach(title => {
        const item = this.findBankItem(title);
        if (!item) return;
        zone.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', this.cardHtml(item, false));
        placed++;
      });
    });

    if (placed === 0) {
      this.board.boardEl.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
        '<div class="schedule-empty"><i class="fas fa-list"></i><br>ЭТА БАЗА ЕЩЁ НЕ РАСПРЕДЕЛЕНА<br><span style="font-size:0.8rem;">Нажмите «ИЗМЕНИТЬ», чтобы собрать тирлист</span></div>');
    }
  }

  async renderEditState(type, token) {
    const saved = this.readSavedState(type);
    if (token !== this.loadToken) return;

    this.tiers = (saved && Array.isArray(saved.tiers) && saved.tiers.length > 0)
      ? saved.tiers.map(t => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name, color: t.color }))
      : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_TIERS));

    const locations = (saved && saved.items) || {};
    this.board.renderBoard();
    this.poolEl.innerHTML = '';

    this.dataBank.forEach(item => {
      const zoneId = locations[item.title];
      const zone = zoneId ? this.board.boardEl.querySelector(`.tier-content[data-zone="${zoneId}"]`) : null;
      (zone || this.poolEl).insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', this.cardHtml(item, true));
    });

    this.updateCounter();
  }

  /* ==================== ХРАНИЛИЩЕ ==================== */

  readSavedState(type) {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`tierlist_master_${type}`);
      if (!raw) return null;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') throw new Error('Некорректная структура');
      return parsed;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`⚠️ [Tierlist] Локальное состояние "${type}" повреждено и будет сброшено:`, error.message);
      try { localStorage.removeItem(`tierlist_master_${type}`); } catch (e) { /* приватный режим */ }
      return null;
    }
  }

  saveState() {
    if (!this.isEditMode) return;
    try {
      const payload = { tiers: this.tiers, items: this.collectItemsState() };
      localStorage.setItem(`tierlist_master_${this.currentMode}`, JSON.stringify(payload));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('🚨 [Tierlist] Не удалось сохранить состояние:', error.message);
      EventBus.emit('SYS_LOG', {
        type: 'system', tag: 'TIERLIST', action: 'SAVE',
        value: 'STORAGE_ERROR', color: 'var(--color-danger-red)'
      });
    }
  }

  collectItemsState() {
    const state = {};
    this.board.boardEl.querySelectorAll('.tier-content').forEach(zone => {
      zone.querySelectorAll('.t-card').forEach(card => { state[card.dataset.id] = zone.dataset.zone; });
    });
    return state;
  }

  updateCounter() {
    if (!this.isEditMode || !this.counterEl) return;
    const left = this.poolEl.querySelectorAll('.t-card').length;
    this.counterEl.textContent = `ОСТАЛОСЬ: ${left}`;
    const done = left === 0;
    this.counterEl.style.color = done ? 'var(--color-neon-green)' : 'var(--color-text-white)';
    this.counterEl.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-neon-green)';
    this.counterEl.style.background = done ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neon-green) 12%, transparent)' : 'transparent';
  }

  /* ==================== УПРАВЛЕНИЕ ==================== */

  toggleEditMode(enable) {
    if (this.isEditMode === enable) return;
    EventBus.emit('PLAY_SOUND', 'click');
    AppRouter.updateQuery({ edit: enable ? '1' : null });
  }

  setupButtons() {
    const btnHome = document.getElementById('btn-back-home');
    if (btnHome) {
      btnHome.addEventListener('click', () => {
        EventBus.emit('PLAY_SOUND', 'click');
        const home = AppRouter.getHomeTarget();
        AppRouter.navigate(home.path, home.params);
      });
    }

    const btnEnable = document.getElementById('btn-enable-edit');
    if (btnEnable) btnEnable.addEventListener('click', () => this.toggleEditMode(true));
    const btnExit = document.getElementById('btn-exit-edit');
    if (btnExit) btnExit.addEventListener('click', () => this.toggleEditMode(false));

    if (this.btnGames) {
      this.btnGames.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (this.currentMode === 'games') return;
        EventBus.emit('PLAY_SOUND', 'click');
        AppRouter.navigate('/tierlist', { type: 'games' }, this.isEditMode ? { edit: '1' } : {});
      });
    }
    if (this.btnMovies) {
      this.btnMovies.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (this.currentMode === 'movies') return;
        EventBus.emit('PLAY_SOUND', 'click');
        AppRouter.navigate('/tierlist', { type: 'movies' }, this.isEditMode ? { edit: '1' } : {});
      });
    }

    const btnReset = document.getElementById('btn-reset');
    if (btnReset) {
      btnReset.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!this.isEditMode) return;
        if (!confirm('Сбросить весь тирлист к заводским настройкам? Все локальные данные будут утеряны.')) return;
        try { localStorage.removeItem(`tierlist_master_${this.currentMode}`); }
        catch (error) { console.warn('⚠️ [Tierlist] Не удалось очистить хранилище:', error.message); }
        this.loadedKey = null;
        this.loadCategory(this.currentMode);
      });
    }
  }
}

/* js/tierlist/TierlistDragDrop.js */
import EventBus from '../event-bus.js';
import { AppStore } from '../store.js';
import { AppRouter } from '../router.js';

/**
 * Drag & Drop тирлиста.
 * Dropzone-слушатели навешиваются один раз на узел (WeakSet),
 * поэтому повторные рендеры не размножают обработчики.
 */
export class TierlistDragDrop {
    constructor(controller) {
        this.ctrl = controller;
        this.draggedCard = null;
        this.draggedRow = null;
        this.boundZones = new WeakSet();
        this.setupBoardDropzone();
    }

    bindRowDragEvents(row) {
        if (row.dataset.dragBound === '1') return;
        row.dataset.dragBound = '1';

        row.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
            if (e.target.closest('.t-card')) return;
            this.draggedRow = row;
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            setTimeout(() => row.classList.add('is-dragging-row'), 0);
        });

        row.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
            if (this.draggedRow) {
                this.draggedRow.classList.remove('is-dragging-row');
                this.ctrl.board.syncTiersFromDOM();
                this.ctrl.saveState();
            }
            this.draggedRow = null;
        });
    }

    setupBoardDropzone() {
        const boardEl = this.ctrl.board.boardEl;
        if (!boardEl || this.boundZones.has(boardEl)) return;
        this.boundZones.add(boardEl);

        boardEl.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
            if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode || !this.draggedRow) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            const after = this.getDragAfterRow(boardEl, e.clientY);
            if (after == null) boardEl.appendChild(this.draggedRow);
            else boardEl.insertBefore(this.draggedRow, after);
        });
    }

    getDragAfterRow(container, y) {
        const rows = [...container.querySelectorAll('.tier-row:not(.is-dragging-row)')];
        return rows.reduce((closest, child) => {
            const box = child.getBoundingClientRect();
            const offset = y - box.top - box.height / 2;
            if (offset < 0 && offset > closest.offset) return { offset, element: child };
            return closest;
        }, { offset: Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY }).element;
    }

    getDragAfterElement(container, x, y) {
        const cards = [...container.querySelectorAll('.t-card:not(.is-dragging)')];
        return cards.reduce((closest, child) => {
            const box = child.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (y >= box.top && y <= box.bottom) {
                const offset = x - box.left - box.width / 2;
                if (offset < 0 && offset > closest.offset) return { offset, element: child };
            }
            return closest;
        }, { offset: Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY }).element;
    }

    setupDropzone(zone) {
        if (!zone || this.boundZones.has(zone)) return;
        this.boundZones.add(zone);

        zone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
            if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode || !this.draggedCard) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            zone.classList.add('drag-over');
            const after = this.getDragAfterElement(zone, e.clientX, e.clientY);
            if (after == null) zone.appendChild(this.draggedCard);
            else zone.insertBefore(this.draggedCard, after);
        });

        zone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => zone.classList.remove('drag-over'));

        zone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
            if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode || !this.draggedCard) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            zone.classList.remove('drag-over');
            this.ctrl.saveState();
            this.ctrl.updateCounter();
        });
    }

    bindCardEvents() {
        const root = this.ctrl.container;
        if (!root) return;

        root.querySelectorAll('.t-card').forEach(card => {
            if (card.dataset.bound === '1') return;
            card.dataset.bound = '1';

            card.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
                if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
                e.stopPropagation();
                this.draggedCard = card;
                setTimeout(() => card.classList.add('is-dragging'), 0);
            });

            card.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
                if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode) return;
                if (this.draggedCard) {
                    this.draggedCard.classList.remove('is-dragging');
                    this.ctrl.saveState();
                    this.ctrl.updateCounter();
                }
                this.draggedCard = null;
            });

            card.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const title = card.dataset.id;
                const item = this.ctrl.findBankItem(title);
                if (!item) {
                    console.warn(`⚠️ [Tierlist] Объект "${title}" не найден в базе категории.`);
                    return;
                }
                EventBus.emit('PLAY_SOUND', 'expand');
                const query = { from: 'tierlist' };
                if (this.ctrl.isEditMode) query.edit = '1';
                AppRouter.navigate('/item', { id: item.id || item.title }, query);
            });
        });
    }
}

/* js/tierlist/TierlistExporter.js */
/**
 * Экспорт тирлиста в JSON и PNG.
 * Экспорт гарантирует снятие служебного класса body даже при ошибке
 * или уходе со страницы посреди рендера.
 */
export class TierlistExporter {
    constructor(controller) {
        this.ctrl = controller;
        this.isExporting = false;
        this.btnPng = document.getElementById('btn-export-png');
        this.btnPngDefaultHtml = this.btnPng ? this.btnPng.innerHTML : '';
        this.bindEvents();
    }

    bindEvents() {
        const btnJson = document.getElementById('btn-export-json');
        if (btnJson) btnJson.addEventListener('click', () => this.exportJson());
        if (this.btnPng) this.btnPng.addEventListener('click', () => this.exportPng());
    }

    exportJson() {
        if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode) return;
        try {
            const boardEl = this.ctrl.board.boardEl;
            const payload = {
                metadata: { generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), category: this.ctrl.currentMode },
                tiers: this.ctrl.tiers.map(tier => {
                    const zone = boardEl.querySelector(`.tier-content[data-zone="${tier.id}"]`);
                    const items = zone ? Array.from(zone.querySelectorAll('.t-card')).map(c => c.dataset.id) : [];
                    return { id: tier.id, name: tier.name, color: tier.color, items };
                }),
                unassigned: Array.from(this.ctrl.poolEl.querySelectorAll('.t-card')).map(c => c.dataset.id)
            };

            const href = 'data:text/json;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2));
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = href;
            link.download = `tierlist-static-${this.ctrl.currentMode}.json`;
            link.click();
            console.log(`📋 [Tierlist] JSON экспортирован (${this.ctrl.currentMode})`);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('🚨 [Tierlist] Ошибка экспорта JSON:', error);
            alert('Не удалось сохранить JSON: ' + error.message);
        }
    }

    async exportPng() {
        if (!this.ctrl.isEditMode || this.isExporting) return;

        if (typeof window.html2canvas !== 'function') {
            alert('Модуль html2canvas не загрузился. Проверьте соединение и повторите.');
            console.warn('⚠️ [Tierlist] html2canvas недоступен — экспорт PNG отменён.');
            return;
        }

        this.isExporting = true;
        if (this.btnPng) this.btnPng.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> ОБРАБОТКА...';
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
        document.body.classList.add('is-exporting');

        try {
            await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
            const captureZone = document.getElementById('capture-zone');
            if (!captureZone) throw new Error('Область захвата не найдена');

            const bgColor = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
                .getPropertyValue('--color-bg-dark').trim() || '#050508';

            const canvas = await window.html2canvas(captureZone, {
                backgroundColor: bgColor,
                scale: 2,
                logging: false,
                useCORS: true,
                scrollY: -window.scrollY
            });

            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.download = `Tetla_TierList_${this.ctrl.currentMode}_${new Date().toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')}.png`;
            link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
            link.click();
            console.log(`📋 [Tierlist] PNG экспортирован (${this.ctrl.currentMode})`);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('🚨 [Tierlist] Ошибка экспорта PNG:', error);
            alert('Ошибка при сохранении: ' + error.message);
        } finally {
            this.cleanup();
        }
    }

    cleanup() {
        document.body.classList.remove('is-exporting');
        if (this.btnPng) this.btnPng.innerHTML = this.btnPngDefaultHtml;
        this.isExporting = false;
    }
}

/* js/tierlist/TierlistSearch.js */
import { AppStore } from '../store.js';
import { SearchEngine } from '../services/SearchEngine.js';
import { SearchBox } from '../components/SearchBox.js';

/**
 * Поиск пула тирлиста — адаптер над SearchBox с кастомным DOM-источником.
 * Дублированная карта EN_TO_RU удалена: раскладка берётся из SearchEngine.
 * Enter/выбор подсказки не навигируют, а фильтруют пул на месте.
 */
export class TierlistSearch {
  constructor(controller) {
    this.ctrl = controller;
    this.box = null;

    const mount = document.getElementById('tierlist-search-mount');
    if (!mount) {
      console.warn('⚠️ [Tierlist] Mount поиска не найден — модуль отключён.');
      return;
    }

    this.box = new SearchBox({
      mount,
      scope: 'custom',
      variant: 'compact',
      accent: 'green',
      size: 'sm',
      placeholder: 'Поиск по базе...',
      maxSuggestions: 8,
      minScore: 15,
      debounceMs: 300,
      source: () => this.readPoolItems(),
      isHotkeyActive: () => AppStore.getState().route.path === '/tierlist' && this.ctrl.isEditMode,
      onSubmit: (query) => this.filterGlobalPool(query)
    });

    console.log('🔎 [Tierlist] TierlistSearch подключён к единому SearchBox');
  }

  /** Источник данных: карточки, реально лежащие в пуле. */
  readPoolItems() {
    if (!this.ctrl.poolEl) return [];
    return Array.from(this.ctrl.poolEl.querySelectorAll('.t-card')).map(card => {
      const imgEl = card.querySelector('img');
      return {
        id: card.dataset.id || card.dataset.title,
        title: card.dataset.title || '',
        image: (imgEl && imgEl.src) || ''
      };
    });
  }

  filterGlobalPool(query) {
    if (!this.ctrl.poolEl) return;
    const clean = String(query || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const layoutSwitched = SearchEngine.switchLayout(clean);
    this.ctrl.poolEl.querySelectorAll('.t-card').forEach(card => {
      const title = (card.dataset.title || '').toLowerCase();
      const visible = !clean || title.includes(clean) || title.includes(layoutSwitched);
      card.style.display = visible ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
  }

  /* Совместимый API для TierlistController */
  toggleSuggestions(isOpen) { if (this.box) this.box.toggleSuggestions(isOpen); }

  reset() {
    if (this.box) this.box.reset();
    this.filterGlobalPool('');
  }
}

File: js\ui\AutoScrollController.js

/* js/ui/AutoScrollController.js */
import EventBus from '../event-bus.js';
import { AppStore } from '../store.js';
import { MobileOptimizer } from '../services/MobileOptimizer.js';
import { Icons } from '../utils/icons.js';

/**
 * КАСТОМНЫЙ АВТОСКРОЛЛ КОЛЕСОМ МЫШИ (v2)
 *
 * Исправления v2:
 *  - Повторный middle-click во время сессии теперь тоже глушит
 *    preventDefault(), поэтому системный виджет автоскролла НЕ появляется
 *    на втором клике. Цикл стал честным: клик = старт, клик = стоп.
 *  - Якорь перерисован в цельную «капсулу» (шеврон ↑ / ромб / шеврон ↓),
 *    чтобы читался как единый контрол, а не набор разрозненных фигур.
 *
 * Физика: скорость пропорциональна расстоянию курсора от якоря,
 * мёртвая зона, плавный разгон (lerp), dt-нормализация, накопление
 * дробного остатка скролла. Курсор узнаёт о режиме через EventBus.
 */

const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    deadZone: 24,        // px вокруг якоря без движения
    speedFactor: 0.012,  // px/ms на каждый px дистанции сверх мёртвой зоны
    maxSpeed: 2.2,       // px/ms
    accelSmoothing: 0.18 // lerp-разгон за кадр 60fps
};

// Зоны, где middle-click обязан остаться нативным (новая вкладка / paste)
const SKIP_SELECTOR = 'a, button, input, textarea, select, label, [contenteditable="true"], [role="button"], .ally-terminal';

export class AutoScrollController {
    constructor(options = {}) {
        this.isInitialized = false;

        if (MobileOptimizer.isMobile() || window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) {
            console.log('🖱️ [AutoScroll] Тач-устройство. Кастомный автоскролл отключен.');
            return;
        }

        this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...options };

        this.isActive = false;
        this.scrollTarget = null; // HTMLElement | window
        this.anchorX = 0;
        this.anchorY = 0;
        this.pointerX = 0;
        this.pointerY = 0;
        this.currentSpeed = 0;
        this.scrollRemainder = 0;
        this.lastDir = 'idle';

        this.rafId = null;
        this.lastFrameTime = 0;
        this.anchorEl = null;
        this.routeUnsub = null;

        this.loop = this.loop.bind(this);
        this.onMouseDown = this.onMouseDown.bind(this);
        this.onMouseMove = this.onMouseMove.bind(this);
        this.onWheel = this.onWheel.bind(this);
        this.onKeyDown = this.onKeyDown.bind(this);
        this.onWindowBlur = this.onWindowBlur.bind(this);
        this.onHashChange = this.onHashChange.bind(this);
        this.onTouchStart = this.onTouchStart.bind(this);

        try {
            this.bindEvents();
            this.isInitialized = true;
            console.log('🖱️ [AutoScroll] v2 инициализирован (капсула-якорь, честный toggle)');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('🚨 [AutoScroll] Ошибка инициализации:', error);
            this.destroy();
        }
    }

    bindEvents() {
        // Capture: гасим системный виджет до дефолтного действия браузера
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', this.onMouseDown, true);
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', this.onMouseMove, { passive: true });
        // Capture: выход по wheel срабатывает ДО SmoothWheelScroller
        document.addEventListener('wheel', this.onWheel, { capture: true, passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKeyDown);
        document.addEventListener('touchstart', this.onTouchStart, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('blur', this.onWindowBlur);
        window.addEventListener('hashchange', this.onHashChange);

        this.routeUnsub = AppStore.subscribe((state, prevState) => {
            if (!this.isActive) return;
            const prevPath = prevState && prevState.route ? prevState.route.path : null;
            if (state.route.path !== prevPath) this.stop('route');
        });
    }

    /* ==================== ДЕТЕКТ ЦЕЛИ СКРОЛЛА ==================== */

    resolveScrollTarget(fromEl) {
        let node = (fromEl instanceof Element) ? fromEl : null;
        while (node && node !== document.body && node !== document.documentElement) {
            try {
                const style = window.getComputedStyle(node);
                if ((style.overflowY === 'auto' || style.overflowY === 'scroll') &&
                    node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight + 1) {
                    return node;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('⚠️ [AutoScroll] Ошибка чтения стилей предка:', error.message);
            }
            node = node.parentElement;
        }

        const htmlStyle = window.getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        const bodyStyle = window.getComputedStyle(document.body);
        if (htmlStyle.overflowY === 'hidden' || bodyStyle.overflowY === 'hidden') return null;

        const maxScroll = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
        return maxScroll > 1 ? window : null;
    }

    /* ==================== СТАРТ / СТОП ==================== */

    onMouseDown(e) {
        // Любой клик во время сессии — выход.
        // ВАЖНО: middle-click при выходе тоже глушим, иначе браузер
        // показывает свой системный автоскролл на втором клике.
        if (this.isActive) {
            if (e.button === 1) e.preventDefault();
            this.stop('click');
            return;
        }
        if (e.button !== 1) return;

        const target = e.target;
        if (target instanceof Element && target.closest(SKIP_SELECTOR)) return;

        // Идёт якорная smooth-прокрутка — не вмешиваемся, но системный виджет глушим
        if (document.body.classList.contains('is-auto-scrolling')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            return;
        }

        const scrollTarget = this.resolveScrollTarget(target);
        if (!scrollTarget) {
            e.preventDefault();
            return;
        }

        e.preventDefault();
        this.start(e.clientX, e.clientY, scrollTarget);
    }

    start(x, y, scrollTarget) {
        this.isActive = true;
        this.scrollTarget = scrollTarget;
        this.anchorX = x;
        this.anchorY = y;
        this.pointerX = x;
        this.pointerY = y;
        this.currentSpeed = 0;
        this.scrollRemainder = 0;
        this.lastDir = 'idle';

        this.buildAnchor(x, y);
        document.body.classList.add('is-auto-scrolling');
        EventBus.emit('AUTOSCROLL_START');
        EventBus.emit('PLAY_SOUND', 'click');

        this.lastFrameTime = 0;
        this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);

        const targetName = scrollTarget === window
            ? 'WINDOW'
            : (scrollTarget.id ? `#${scrollTarget.id}` : scrollTarget.className || scrollTarget.tagName);
        console.log(`🖱️ [AutoScroll] Захват оси @ (${Math.round(x)}, ${Math.round(y)}) → ${targetName}`);
    }

    stop(reason) {
        if (!this.isActive) return;
        this.isActive = false;

        if (this.rafId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
            this.rafId = null;
        }
        if (this.anchorEl) {
            this.anchorEl.remove();
            this.anchorEl = null;
        }
        document.body.classList.remove('is-auto-scrolling');
        this.scrollTarget = null;
        this.currentSpeed = 0;
        this.scrollRemainder = 0;

        EventBus.emit('AUTOSCROLL_END');
        console.log(`🖱️ [AutoScroll] Сессия завершена (${reason})`);
    }

    /* ==================== ВИЗУАЛ ЯКОРЯ (КАПСУЛА) ==================== */

    buildAnchor(x, y) {
        this.anchorEl = document.createElement('div');
        this.anchorEl.className = 'autoscroll-anchor';
        this.anchorEl.id = 'cyber-autoscroll-anchor';
        this.anchorEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        this.anchorEl.style.left = `${x}px`;
        this.anchorEl.style.top = `${y}px`;
        this.anchorEl.innerHTML = `
            <div class="autoscroll-pulse"></div>
            <div class="autoscroll-capsule">
                <div class="autoscroll-chevron up">${Icons['chevron-up'] || ''}</div>
                <div class="autoscroll-core"></div>
                <div class="autoscroll-chevron down">${Icons['chevron-down'] || ''}</div>
            </div>
        `;
        document.body.appendChild(this.anchorEl);
    }

    /* ==================== ВЫХОДЫ ==================== */

    onMouseMove(e) {
        if (!this.isActive) return;
        this.pointerX = e.clientX;
        this.pointerY = e.clientY;
    }

    onWheel() {
        if (this.isActive) this.stop('wheel');
    }

    onKeyDown(e) {
        if (this.isActive && e.key === 'Escape') this.stop('escape');
    }

    onWindowBlur() {
        if (this.isActive) this.stop('blur');
    }

    onHashChange() {
        if (this.isActive) this.stop('route');
    }

    onTouchStart() {
        if (this.isActive) this.stop('touch');
    }

    /* ==================== ФИЗИКА ==================== */

    loop(now) {
        if (!this.isActive) return;
        this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);

        if (!this.lastFrameTime) this.lastFrameTime = now;
        let dt = now - this.lastFrameTime;
        this.lastFrameTime = now;
        if (dt > 100) dt = 100;

        const delta = this.pointerY - this.anchorY;
        const abs = Math.abs(delta);
        let targetSpeed = 0;
        if (abs > this.config.deadZone) {
            targetSpeed = Math.sign(delta) * Math.min(
                (abs - this.config.deadZone) * this.config.speedFactor,
                this.config.maxSpeed
            );
        }

        const t = 1 - Math.pow(1 - this.config.accelSmoothing, dt / 16.667);
        this.currentSpeed += (targetSpeed - this.currentSpeed) * t;
        if (Math.abs(this.currentSpeed) < 0.001) this.currentSpeed = 0;

        if (this.currentSpeed !== 0 && this.scrollTarget) {
            this.scrollRemainder += this.currentSpeed * dt;
            const step = Math.trunc(this.scrollRemainder);
            if (step !== 0) {
                this.scrollRemainder -= step;
                try {
                    if (this.scrollTarget === window) {
                        window.scrollBy(0, step);
                    } else {
                        this.scrollTarget.scrollTop += step;
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('🚨 [AutoScroll] Ошибка скролла, аварийный выход:', error);
                    this.stop('error');
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        if (this.anchorEl) {
            const dir = this.currentSpeed > 0.02 ? 'down' : this.currentSpeed < -0.02 ? 'up' : 'idle';
            if (dir !== this.lastDir) {
                this.anchorEl.classList.toggle('dir-up', dir === 'up');
                this.anchorEl.classList.toggle('dir-down', dir === 'down');
                this.lastDir = dir;
            }
            const intensity = Math.min(1, Math.abs(this.currentSpeed) / this.config.maxSpeed);
            this.anchorEl.style.setProperty('--as-intensity', intensity.toFixed(3));
        }
    }

    /* ==================== LIFECYCLE ==================== */

    destroy() {
        this.stop('destroy');
        document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.onMouseDown, true);
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.onMouseMove);
        document.removeEventListener('wheel', this.onWheel, { capture: true });
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onKeyDown);
        document.removeEventListener('touchstart', this.onTouchStart);
        window.removeEventListener('blur', this.onWindowBlur);
        window.removeEventListener('hashchange', this.onHashChange);
        if (this.routeUnsub) {
            this.routeUnsub();
            this.routeUnsub = null;
        }
        this.isInitialized = false;
        console.log('🖱️ [AutoScroll] Модуль остановлен, слушатели сняты.');
    }
}

/* js/ui/crypto-widget.js */
import { AppConfig } from '../config.js';

export class CryptoCardManager {
    constructor() {
        this.els = {
            card: document.getElementById('card-number')
        };
        
        this.chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLNPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789#$<>[]/\\";
        this.isAnimating = false;
        
        if (this.els.card) this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.els.digitsContainer = this.els.card.querySelector('.card-digits');
        this.originalHTML = this.els.digitsContainer.innerHTML;
        
        this.els.card.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (this.isAnimating) return; 
            this.isAnimating = true;
            
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(AppConfig.crypto.cardNumberClean).then(() => {
                this.els.card.classList.add('copied');
                this.els.digitsContainer.classList.add('success-mode');
                
                this.els.digitsContainer.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
                this.els.digitsContainer.style.wordBreak = 'keep-all';
                
                this.runDecryptEffect(AppConfig.crypto.successMessage, () => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        this.runDecryptEffect(AppConfig.crypto.cardNumberRaw, () => {
                            this.els.digitsContainer.style.whiteSpace = ''; 
                            this.els.digitsContainer.style.wordBreak = ''; 
                            this.els.digitsContainer.classList.remove('success-mode');
                            this.els.digitsContainer.innerHTML = this.originalHTML; 
                            this.els.card.classList.remove('copied');
                            this.isAnimating = false;
                        });
                    }, 2000);
                });
            });
        });
    }

    runDecryptEffect(targetText, onComplete) {
        const startText = this.els.digitsContainer.innerText;
        const startLen = startText.length;
        const targetLen = targetText.length;
        
        const glitchWidth = 4; 
        const maxIters = Math.max(startLen, targetLen) + glitchWidth;
        let iterations = 0;
        
        if (this.intervalId) clearInterval(this.intervalId);

        this.intervalId = setInterval(() => {
            let displayText = "";
            const progress = Math.min(iterations / maxIters, 1);
            const currentLen = Math.floor(startLen + (targetLen - startLen) * progress);
            
            for (let i = 0; i < currentLen; i++) {
                if (i < iterations - glitchWidth) {
                    displayText += targetText[i] !== undefined ? targetText[i] : "";
                } else if (i < iterations) {
                    displayText += this.chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * this.chars.length)];
                } else {
                    displayText += startText[i] !== undefined ? startText[i] : "";
                }
            }
            
            this.els.digitsContainer.textContent = displayText.replace(/ /g, '\u00A0');
            iterations += 0.5; 
            
            if (iterations >= maxIters) { 
                clearInterval(this.intervalId);
                this.els.digitsContainer.textContent = targetText.replace(/ /g, '\u00A0'); 
                if (onComplete) onComplete();
            }
        }, 30); 
    }
}

export function initCryptoWidget() {
    new CryptoCardManager();
    console.log('💳 [UI] Крипто-виджет инициализирован');
}

/* js/ui/CursorController.js */
import { MobileOptimizer } from '../services/MobileOptimizer.js';
import EventBus from '../event-bus.js';
import { Icons } from '../utils/icons.js';

const STATE_CLASSES = ['is-hovering', 'is-text', 'is-external'];

/**
 * КАСТОМНЫЙ КУРСОР «ТАКТИЧЕСКИЙ ПРИЦЕЛ»
 *
 * Плавность:
 *  - позиция кольца — dt-нормализованный lerp в JS;
 *  - размер/раскрытие углов — transform: scale() внутреннего frame (GPU);
 *  - цвета/прозрачность — CSS-переходы;
 *  - гистерезис: возврат к базовому виду откладывается, чтобы курсор
 *    не «щёлкал» при проходе между соседними кнопками.
 *
 * Живые детали (CSS-анимации):
 *  - текстовая каретка мигает как настоящий caret (step-end);
 *  - стрелка внешней ссылки слегка пульсирует размером.
 *
 * Fail-safe: системный курсор прячется только классом html.has-cyber-cursor.
 */
export class CursorController {
    constructor() {
        this.isInitialized = false;

        if (MobileOptimizer.isMobile() || window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) {
            console.log('🖱️ [Cursor] Тач-устройство. Кастомный курсор отключен.');
            return;
        }

        this.dot = null;
        this.ring = null;

        this.targetX = window.innerWidth / 2;
        this.targetY = window.innerHeight / 2;
        this.ringX = this.targetX;
        this.ringY = this.targetY;
        this.speed = 0.2;

        this.isVisible = false;
        this.currentState = 'default';
        this.lastHoverTarget = null;

        this.pendingState = null;
        this.stateTimer = null;
        this.downgradeDelay = 70;

        this.rafId = null;
        this.lastFrameTime = 0;
        this.lastRenderX = NaN;
        this.lastRenderY = NaN;

        this.interactiveSelectors = [
            'a', 'button', 'label', 'select', '[role="button"]',
            'input[type="button"]', 'input[type="submit"]', 'input[type="checkbox"]', 'input[type="radio"]',
            '.cyber-btn', '.cyber-btn-outline', '.interactive-cmd', '.magic-toggle',
            '.sort-btn', '.density-btn', '.switcher-btn', '.jumper-btn', '.matrix-btn',
            '.tuner-slot', '.cyber-page-btn-vert', '.close-detail-btn', '.music-btn',
            '.archive-card-container', '.t-card', '.track-item', '.item-playlist-card',
            '.yt-playlist-card', '.sched-card', '.donate-card', '.agent-list-card',
            '.squad-member', '.ally-net-card', '.lib-tab-btn',
            '.nav-marker', '.card-number-box', '.search-icon', '.suggestion-item',
            '.agent-tierlist-preview', '.suggested-status', '.agent-twitch-btn',
            '.hud-btn', '.music-progress-area', '.volume-ticks-container',
            '.color-picker-wrapper', '.add-row-btn', '.row-btn', '.drag-grip',
            '.poster-dot', '.item-poster-wrapper.is-interactive', '.holo-card'
        ].join(', ');

        this.textSelectors = 'input[type="text"], input[type="password"], input[type="search"], input[type="email"], input[type="number"], input:not([type]), textarea, .ally-terminal, [contenteditable="true"]';
        this.externalSelectors = 'a[target="_blank"], [data-cursor="external"]';

        this.reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
        this.prefersReducedMotion = this.reducedMotionQuery.matches;

        this.loop = this.loop.bind(this);
        this.onMouseMove = this.onMouseMove.bind(this);
        this.onMouseDown = this.onMouseDown.bind(this);
        this.onMouseUp = this.onMouseUp.bind(this);
        this.onKeyDown = this.onKeyDown.bind(this);
        this.onMouseOver = this.onMouseOver.bind(this);
        this.onDocMouseOut = this.onDocMouseOut.bind(this);
        this.onWindowBlur = this.onWindowBlur.bind(this);
        this.onAutoScrollStart = this.onAutoScrollStart.bind(this);
        this.onAutoScrollEnd = this.onAutoScrollEnd.bind(this);
        this.onReducedMotionChange = this.onReducedMotionChange.bind(this);

        try {
            this.init();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('🚨 [Cursor] Ошибка инициализации, возвращаю системный курсор:', error);
            this.destroy();
        }
    }

    init() {
        this.buildDOM();
        document.documentElement.classList.add('has-cyber-cursor');
        this.bindEvents();
        this.isInitialized = true;
        this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
        console.log('🎯 [Cursor] Инициализирован (мигающая каретка + пульс внешней стрелки)');
    }

    buildDOM() {
        this.dot = document.createElement('div');
        this.dot.id = 'cyber-cursor-dot';
        this.dot.className = 'is-hidden';
        this.dot.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

        this.ring = document.createElement('div');
        this.ring.id = 'cyber-cursor-ring';
        this.ring.className = 'is-hidden';
        this.ring.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        this.ring.innerHTML = `
            <div class="cursor-ring-frame">
                <div class="cursor-corner tl"></div>
                <div class="cursor-corner tr"></div>
                <div class="cursor-corner bl"></div>
                <div class="cursor-corner br"></div>
                <div class="cursor-external-badge" aria-hidden="true">${Icons['arrow-up'] || ''}</div>
                <div class="cursor-autoscroll-glyph" aria-hidden="true">
                    <span>${Icons['chevron-up'] || ''}</span>
                    <span>${Icons['chevron-down'] || ''}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;

        document.body.appendChild(this.ring);
        document.body.appendChild(this.dot);
    }

    bindEvents() {
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', this.onMouseMove, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', this.onMouseDown);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', this.onMouseUp);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKeyDown);
        document.addEventListener('mouseover', this.onMouseOver, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('mouseout', this.onDocMouseOut, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('blur', this.onWindowBlur);

        EventBus.on('AUTOSCROLL_START', this.onAutoScrollStart);
        EventBus.on('AUTOSCROLL_END', this.onAutoScrollEnd);

        try {
            this.reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', this.onReducedMotionChange);
        } catch (e) {
            if (this.reducedMotionQuery.addListener) this.reducedMotionQuery.addListener(this.onReducedMotionChange);
        }
    }

    /* ==================== СОБЫТИЯ ==================== */

    onMouseMove(e) {
        this.targetX = e.clientX;
        this.targetY = e.clientY;

        if (!this.isVisible) this.setVisible(true);

        if (this.dot) {
            this.dot.style.transform = `translate3d(${this.targetX}px, ${this.targetY}px, 0)`;
        }

        const target = e.target;
        if (target !== this.lastHoverTarget || (this.lastHoverTarget && !this.lastHoverTarget.isConnected)) {
            this.lastHoverTarget = target;
            this.requestState(this.resolveState(target));
        }
    }

    onMouseDown() {
        if (!this.dot || !this.ring) return;
        this.dot.classList.add('is-clicking');
        this.ring.classList.add('is-clicking');
    }

    onMouseUp() {
        if (!this.dot || !this.ring) return;
        this.dot.classList.remove('is-clicking');
        this.ring.classList.remove('is-clicking');
    }

    onKeyDown(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Tab') this.setVisible(false);
    }

    onMouseOver(e) {
        const target = e.target;
        if (target && target.tagName === 'IFRAME') this.setVisible(false);
    }

    onDocMouseOut(e) {
        if (!e.relatedTarget) this.setVisible(false);
    }

    onWindowBlur() {
        if (this.dot) this.dot.classList.remove('is-clicking');
        if (this.ring) this.ring.classList.remove('is-clicking');
        const active = document.activeElement;
        if (active && active.tagName === 'IFRAME') this.setVisible(false);
    }

    onAutoScrollStart() {
        if (!this.dot || !this.ring) return;
        this.cancelPending();
        this.dot.classList.add('is-autoscroll');
        this.ring.classList.add('is-autoscroll');
        this.lastHoverTarget = null;
        this.applyState('default');
    }

    onAutoScrollEnd() {
        if (!this.dot || !this.ring) return;
        this.dot.classList.remove('is-autoscroll');
        this.ring.classList.remove('is-autoscroll');
        this.lastHoverTarget = null;
    }

    onReducedMotionChange(e) {
        this.prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
    }

    /* ==================== СТЕЙТ-МАШИНА ==================== */

    resolveState(target) {
        if (!target || !(target instanceof Element)) return 'default';
        try {
            if (target.closest(this.textSelectors)) return 'text';
            if (target.closest(this.externalSelectors)) return 'external';
            if (target.closest(this.interactiveSelectors)) return 'interactive';
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('⚠️ [Cursor] Ошибка resolveState:', error.message);
        }
        return 'default';
    }

    requestState(next) {
        if (next === this.currentState) {
            this.cancelPending();
            return;
        }
        if (next === 'default' && this.currentState !== 'default') {
            this.cancelPending();
            this.pendingState = next;
            this.stateTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                this.stateTimer = null;
                const pending = this.pendingState;
                this.pendingState = null;
                if (pending !== null) this.applyState(pending);
            }, this.downgradeDelay);
        } else {
            this.cancelPending();
            this.applyState(next);
        }
    }

    cancelPending() {
        if (this.stateTimer) {
            clearTimeout(this.stateTimer);
            this.stateTimer = null;
        }
        this.pendingState = null;
    }

    applyState(state) {
        if (state === this.currentState || !this.dot || !this.ring) return;
        this.currentState = state;
        this.dot.classList.remove(...STATE_CLASSES);
        this.ring.classList.remove(...STATE_CLASSES);
        if (state === 'interactive') {
            this.dot.classList.add('is-hovering');
            this.ring.classList.add('is-hovering');
        } else if (state === 'text') {
            this.dot.classList.add('is-text');
            this.ring.classList.add('is-text');
        } else if (state === 'external') {
            this.dot.classList.add('is-external');
            this.ring.classList.add('is-external');
        }
    }

    /* ==================== ВИДИМОСТЬ ==================== */

    setVisible(visible) {
        if (this.isVisible === visible || !this.dot || !this.ring) return;
        this.isVisible = visible;
        this.dot.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !visible);
        this.ring.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !visible);
        if (visible) {
            this.ringX = this.targetX;
            this.ringY = this.targetY;
            this.renderRing(true);
        } else {
            this.cancelPending();
            this.applyState('default');
        }
    }

    /* ==================== ФИЗИКА ==================== */

    loop(now) {
        this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);

        if (!this.isVisible) {
            this.lastFrameTime = now;
            return;
        }

        if (!this.lastFrameTime) this.lastFrameTime = now;
        let dt = now - this.lastFrameTime;
        this.lastFrameTime = now;
        if (dt > 100) dt = 100;

        if (this.prefersReducedMotion) {
            this.ringX = this.targetX;
            this.ringY = this.targetY;
        } else {
            const t = 1 - Math.pow(1 - this.speed, dt / 16.667);
            this.ringX += (this.targetX - this.ringX) * t;
            this.ringY += (this.targetY - this.ringY) * t;
            if (Math.abs(this.targetX - this.ringX) < 0.1) this.ringX = this.targetX;
            if (Math.abs(this.targetY - this.ringY) < 0.1) this.ringY = this.targetY;
        }

        this.renderRing(false);
    }

    renderRing(force) {
        if (!this.ring) return;
        if (!force &&
            Math.abs(this.ringX - this.lastRenderX) < 0.05 &&
            Math.abs(this.ringY - this.lastRenderY) < 0.05) return;
        this.lastRenderX = this.ringX;
        this.lastRenderY = this.ringY;
        this.ring.style.transform = `translate3d(${this.ringX}px, ${this.ringY}px, 0)`;
    }

    /* ==================== LIFECYCLE ==================== */

    destroy() {
        this.cancelPending();
        if (this.rafId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
            this.rafId = null;
        }
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.onMouseMove);
        document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.onMouseDown);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.onMouseUp);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onKeyDown);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseover', this.onMouseOver);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseout', this.onDocMouseOut);
        window.removeEventListener('blur', this.onWindowBlur);
        EventBus.off('AUTOSCROLL_START', this.onAutoScrollStart);
        EventBus.off('AUTOSCROLL_END', this.onAutoScrollEnd);
        try {
            this.reducedMotionQuery.removeEventListener('change', this.onReducedMotionChange);
        } catch (e) {
            if (this.reducedMotionQuery.removeListener) this.reducedMotionQuery.removeListener(this.onReducedMotionChange);
        }
        if (this.dot) { this.dot.remove(); this.dot = null; }
        if (this.ring) { this.ring.remove(); this.ring = null; }
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('has-cyber-cursor');
        this.isInitialized = false;
        console.log('🎯 [Cursor] Остановлен, системный курсор восстановлен.');
    }
}

/* js/ui/nav-rail.js */
import EventBus from '../event-bus.js';
import { AppStore } from '../store.js'; 
import { customSmoothScroll } from './scroll-physics.js';

export class NavRailManager {
    constructor() {
        this.sections = [
            { id: 'hero', label: 'ГЛАВНАЯ' },
            { id: 'about', label: 'ОБО МНЕ' },
            { id: 'command-center', label: 'КОМАНДНЫЙ ЦЕНТР' },
            { id: 'media-archive', label: 'БАЗА ДАННЫХ' },
            { id: 'specs', label: 'ЖЕЛЕЗО' },
            { id: 'donation', label: 'ДОНАТ' }
        ];
        
        this.ticking = false;    
        this.currentActiveId = null;
        this.isReady = false; 
        this.lastDocHeight = 0; 
        
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.rail = document.createElement('div');
        this.rail.className = 'cyber-nav-rail';
        this.rail.id = 'cyber-nav-rail';
        
        this.rail.style.opacity = '0';
        this.rail.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)';

        this.laserBeam = document.createElement('div');
        this.laserBeam.className = 'nav-laser-beam';
        this.rail.appendChild(this.laserBeam);

        document.body.appendChild(this.rail);

        this.sections.forEach(sec => {
            const marker = document.createElement('div');
            marker.className = 'nav-marker';
            marker.id = `nav-marker-${sec.id}`; 
            
            marker.innerHTML = `<div class="nav-shape"></div><div class="nav-tooltip">${sec.label}</div>`;
            
            marker.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (sec.targetScroll !== undefined) {
                    customSmoothScroll(sec.targetScroll, 800);
                }
            });
            
            this.rail.appendChild(marker);
        });

        this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => this.requestUpdate());
        this.resizeObserver.observe(document.documentElement);
        this.resizeObserver.observe(document.body);

        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (!this.ticking) {
                window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    this.updateScrollState();
                    this.ticking = false;
                });
                this.ticking = true;
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        EventBus.on('LAYOUT_CHANGED', () => this.requestUpdate(true));
        EventBus.on('MEDIA_STORE_LOADED', () => this.requestUpdate(true));
        EventBus.on('TWITCH_DATA_UPDATED', () => this.requestUpdate(true));

        setInterval(() => {
            const currentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
            if (currentHeight !== this.lastDocHeight) {
                this.requestUpdate();
            }
        }, 500);

        window.addEventListener('load', () => this.requestUpdate(true));
        this.requestUpdate(true);
    }

    requestUpdate(force = false) {
        if (force || !this.ticking) {
            window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                this.updatePositions();
                this.ticking = false;
            });
            this.ticking = true;
        }
    }

    updatePositions() {
        const currentPath = AppStore.getState().route.path;
        const isDashboard = currentPath === '/' || (currentPath.startsWith('/archive') && !currentPath.startsWith('/item'));

        if (isDashboard && !document.body.classList.contains('route-dashboard')) {
            document.body.classList.add('route-dashboard');
        }

        if (!isDashboard) {
            this.rail.style.opacity = '0';
            this.isReady = false;
            return;
        }

        const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
        const winHeight = window.innerHeight;
        const maxScroll = docHeight - winHeight;
        
        this.lastDocHeight = docHeight; 

        if (maxScroll <= 0) {
            this.rail.style.opacity = '0';
            this.isReady = false;
            return;
        }

        this.sections.forEach((sec, index) => {
            const el = document.getElementById(sec.id);
            if (el) {
                let targetScroll = el.offsetTop - (winHeight * 0.15);
                
                if (index === 0) targetScroll = 0;
                if (index === this.sections.length - 1) targetScroll = maxScroll;

                sec.targetScroll = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxScroll, targetScroll));
                sec.decimal = sec.targetScroll / maxScroll;

                const marker = document.getElementById(`nav-marker-${sec.id}`);
                if (marker) {
                    marker.style.top = `${sec.decimal * 100}%`;
                }
            } else {
                sec.targetScroll = 0;
                sec.decimal = 0;
            }
        });
        
        this.sections.sort((a, b) => a.targetScroll - b.targetScroll);
        
        if (!this.isReady) {
            this.isReady = true;
            this.rail.style.opacity = '1';
        }

        this.updateScrollState();
    }

    setActiveMarker(sectionId) {
        if (this.currentActiveId === sectionId) return;
        this.currentActiveId = sectionId;

        this.sections.forEach(s => {
            const marker = document.getElementById(`nav-marker-${s.id}`);
            if (marker) {
                marker.classList.toggle('active', s.id === sectionId);
            }
        });
    }

    updateScrollState() {
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('route-dashboard') || !this.isReady) return;

        const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
        const winHeight = window.innerHeight;
        const maxScroll = Math.max(1, docHeight - winHeight);
        const scrollY = window.scrollY;

        let globalProgress = scrollY / maxScroll;
        globalProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, globalProgress));

        let activeIndex = 0;
        for (let i = this.sections.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (scrollY >= this.sections[i].targetScroll - 5) {
                activeIndex = i;
                break;
            }
        }

        const activeSec = this.sections[activeIndex];
        this.setActiveMarker(activeSec.id);

        const startDecimal = activeSec.decimal;
        let endDecimal = startDecimal;
        let localProgress = 0;

        if (activeIndex < this.sections.length - 1) {
            const nextSec = this.sections[activeIndex + 1];
            endDecimal = nextSec.decimal;
            
            const segmentHeight = nextSec.targetScroll - activeSec.targetScroll;
            if (segmentHeight > 0) {
                localProgress = (scrollY - activeSec.targetScroll) / segmentHeight;
                localProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, localProgress));
            }
        } else {
            endDecimal = 1.0;
            localProgress = 1;
        }

        const beamHeight = endDecimal - startDecimal;

        this.rail.style.setProperty('--beam-top', startDecimal);
        this.rail.style.setProperty('--beam-height', beamHeight);
        // Передаем в CSS прогресс текущего отрезка для градиентного лазера
        this.rail.style.setProperty('--beam-progress', localProgress.toFixed(3));

        this.sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
            const marker = document.getElementById(`nav-marker-${sec.id}`);
            if (!marker || sec.decimal === undefined) return;
            
            let proximity = 0;
            
            if (idx === activeIndex) {
                proximity = 1;
            } else if (idx === activeIndex + 1) {
                // Эффект зажигания: плавно разгорается вместе с приближением луча
                proximity = Math.pow(localProgress, 1.5);
            } else {
                // Остальные маркеры просто мягко гаснут от расстояния
                let distance = Math.abs(globalProgress - sec.decimal);
                proximity = Math.max(0, 1 - (distance * 4)); 
                proximity = Math.pow(proximity, 3);
            }
            
            marker.style.setProperty('--proximity', proximity.toFixed(3));
        });
    }
}

export function initNavRail() {
    const railInstance = new NavRailManager();
    console.log('🧭 [UI] Навигационный луч инициализирован (Dynamic Gradient Mode)');
    return railInstance;
}

/* js/ui/scroll-physics.js */
/**
* КИБЕР-ФИЗИКА СКРОЛЛА
* Универсальная функция для плавного перемещения камеры по клику (якоря/навигация).
*/
export function customSmoothScroll(targetPosition, duration = 800) {
const startPosition = window.scrollY;
const distance = targetPosition - startPosition;
let startTime = null;
document.body.classList.add('is-auto-scrolling');
function animation(currentTime) {
if (startTime === null) startTime = currentTime;
const timeElapsed = currentTime - startTime;
const progress = Math.min(timeElapsed / duration, 1);
const ease = progress < 0.5
? 8 * progress * progress * progress * progress
: 1 - Math.pow(-2 * progress + 2, 4) / 2;
window.scrollTo(0, startPosition + distance * ease);
if (timeElapsed < duration) {
requestAnimationFrame(animation);
} else {
document.body.classList.remove('is-auto-scrolling');
}
}
requestAnimationFrame(animation);
}
/**
* ГЛОБАЛЬНЫЙ БУСТЕР СКРОЛЛА
* Отключает pointer-events во время прокрутки колесика для повышения FPS.
*/
class GlobalScrollBooster {
constructor() {
this.scrollTimeout = null;
this.isScrolling = false;
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
if (document.body.classList.contains('is-auto-scrolling')) return;
if (!this.isScrolling) {
this.isScrolling = true;
document.body.classList.add('is-mouse-scrolling');
}
clearTimeout(this.scrollTimeout);
this.scrollTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
this.isScrolling = false;
document.body.classList.remove('is-mouse-scrolling');
}, 150);
}, { passive: true });
}
}
/**
* ПЕРЕХВАТЧИК ЯКОРЕЙ
*/
class SmoothScrollManager {
constructor() {
this.init();
}
init() {
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
const anchor = e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
if (anchor) {
const href = anchor.getAttribute('href');
if (href === '#' || href.startsWith('#/')) {
return;
}
e.preventDefault();
const targetId = href.substring(1);
this.scrollTo(targetId);
}
});
}
scrollTo(targetId) {
const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
if (!targetEl) return;
const targetRect = targetEl.getBoundingClientRect();
const viewOffset = window.innerHeight * 0.15;
let targetPosition = targetRect.top + window.scrollY - viewOffset;
customSmoothScroll(Math.max(0, targetPosition), 800);
}
}
/**
* УМЕНЬШИТЕЛЬ ШАГА КОЛЕСИКА МЫШИ
* Делает "тик" мышки в два раза короче и добавляет плавную кинематографичную остановку.
*/
class SmoothWheelScroller {
constructor() {
this.targetY = window.scrollY;
this.currentY = window.scrollY;
this.isAnimating = false;
this.dampening = 0.45;
this.speed = 0.12;
window.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => this.onWheel(e), { passive: false });
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
if (!this.isAnimating) {
this.targetY = window.scrollY;
this.currentY = window.scrollY;
}
}, { passive: true });
}
onWheel(e) {
if (e.ctrlKey || document.body.classList.contains('is-auto-scrolling')) return;
if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) < 50) return;
let target = e.target;
let isInsideScrollable = false;
while (target && target !== document.body && target !== document.documentElement) {
const style = window.getComputedStyle(target);
if ((style.overflowY === 'auto' || style.overflowY === 'scroll') && target.scrollHeight > target.clientHeight) {
isInsideScrollable = true;
break;
}
target = target.parentElement;
}
if (isInsideScrollable) return;
e.preventDefault();
if (!this.isAnimating) {
this.targetY = window.scrollY;
this.currentY = window.scrollY;
}
this.targetY += e.deltaY * this.dampening;
const maxScroll = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
this.targetY = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.targetY, maxScroll));
if (!this.isAnimating) {
this.isAnimating = true;
requestAnimationFrame(() => this.update());
}
}
update() {
if (!this.isAnimating) return;
this.currentY += (this.targetY - this.currentY) * this.speed;
if (Math.abs(this.targetY - this.currentY) < 0.5) {
this.currentY = this.targetY;
window.scrollTo(0, this.currentY);
this.isAnimating = false;
return;
}
window.scrollTo(0, this.currentY);
requestAnimationFrame(() => this.update());
}
}
export function initScrollPhysics() {
new GlobalScrollBooster();
new SmoothScrollManager();
new SmoothWheelScroller();
console.log('⚡ [UI] Физика скролла инициализирована');
}

/* js/ui/SpecsRenderer.js */
import { AppConfig } from '../config.js';

export class SpecsRenderer {
    constructor() {
        this.grid = document.querySelector('.specs-grid');
        this.hasAnimated = false;
        
        if (this.grid) {
            this.init();
        }
    }

    init() {
        this.renderCards();
        this.setupEntranceAnimation();
    }

    renderCards() {
        if (!AppConfig.hardware || AppConfig.hardware.length === 0) return;

        // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Используем animation-delay вместо transition-delay, 
        // чтобы задержка работала только при появлении, а не при наведении.
        // Заодно удалили лишний HTML сканера и линии загрузки.
        const html = AppConfig.hardware.map((hw, index) => `
            <div class="spec-card" style="animation-delay: ${index * 0.15}s">
                <div class="card-glass"></div>
                <div class="spec-content">
                    <div class="spec-icon-box">
                        <i class="${hw.icon}"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div class="spec-info">
                        <h3 class="spec-label">${hw.label}</h3>
                        <p class="spec-value">${hw.value}</p>
                        <div class="spec-meta">
                            ${hw.tags.map(tag => `<span class="meta-tag">${tag}</span>`).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="tech-corner top-right"></div>
                <div class="tech-corner bottom-left"></div>
            </div>
        `).join('');

        this.grid.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Анимация при скролле (Загораются по очереди)
    setupEntranceAnimation() {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting && !this.hasAnimated) {
                    this.hasAnimated = true;
                    this.grid.classList.add('is-visible');
                    observer.disconnect();
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.2 });

        observer.observe(this.grid);
    }
}

export function initSpecs() {
    new SpecsRenderer();
    console.log('💻 [UI] Модуль спецификаций железа загружен');
}

/**
 * Ищет все теги <i> с классами FontAwesome и вставляет внутрь полноценный SVG.
 * Поиск идёт по имени иконки, поэтому папка исходника не важна.
 */
export function replaceIcons(root = document) {
    const iconEls = root.querySelectorAll('i[class*="fa-"]:not(.icon-replaced)');
    iconEls.forEach(el => {
        el.classList.add('icon-replaced');
        const classes = Array.from(el.classList);
        const faClass = classes.find(c => c.startsWith('fa-') && !['fa-spin', 'fa-pulse', 'fa-fw'].includes(c));
        if (!faClass) return;
        const iconName = faClass.replace('fa-', '');
        const svgString = Icons[iconName];
        if (svgString) {
            el.innerHTML = svgString;
            if (classes.includes('fa-spin')) {
                el.classList.add('icon-spin');
            }
        }
    });
}

/* js/utils/ids.js */
/*
 * ГЕНЕРАТОР СТАБИЛЬНЫХ ИДЕНТИФИКАТОРОВ
 * Детерминированный: одни и те же данные -> одни и те же ID навсегда.
 * Никаких Date.now() / Math.random() — иначе deep links умирают при перезагрузке.
 */
import { getYouTubeId } from '../utils.js';

const TRANSLIT = {
    'а': 'a', 'б': 'b', 'в': 'v', 'г': 'g', 'д': 'd', 'е': 'e', 'ё': 'yo',
    'ж': 'zh', 'з': 'z', 'и': 'i', 'й': 'y', 'к': 'k', 'л': 'l', 'м': 'm',
    'н': 'n', 'о': 'o', 'п': 'p', 'р': 'r', 'с': 's', 'т': 't', 'у': 'u',
    'ф': 'f', 'х': 'h', 'ц': 'c', 'ч': 'ch', 'ш': 'sh', 'щ': 'sch',
    'ъ': '', 'ы': 'y', 'ь': '', 'э': 'e', 'ю': 'yu', 'я': 'ya'
};

/** Читаемый slug из любого заголовка (в т.ч. кириллицы). */
export function slugify(input) {
    if (!input) return '';
    const lowered = String(input).toLowerCase();
    let out = '';
    for (const ch of lowered) {
        out += (TRANSLIT[ch] !== undefined) ? TRANSLIT[ch] : ch;
    }
    out = out.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
    if (out.length > 60) out = out.slice(0, 60).replace(/-+$/g, '');
    return out;
}

/** FNV-1a хэш -> base36. Стабилен между сессиями и браузерами. */
export function hashString(str) {
    const text = String(str || '');
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        h ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
        h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
    }
    return h.toString(36);
}

/** Гарантирует уникальность base внутри набора used (детерминированно). */
export function makeUniqueId(base, used) {
    const clean = base || `id-${hashString('empty')}`;
    if (!used) return clean;
    if (!used.has(clean)) {
        used.add(clean);
        return clean;
    }
    let index = 2;
    let candidate = `${clean}-${index}`;
    while (used.has(candidate)) {
        index++;
        candidate = `${clean}-${index}`;
    }
    used.add(candidate);
    console.warn(`⚠️ [IDs] Коллизия идентификатора "${clean}" -> выдан "${candidate}"`);
    return candidate;
}

/** Стабильный «отпечаток» объекта для fallback-хэша. */
function stableSeed(item) {
    try {
        return JSON.stringify({
            t: item?.title || '',
            v: Array.isArray(item?.videos) ? item.videos : [],
            i: item?.image || item?.images || '',
            s: Array.isArray(item?.items) ? item.items.map(x => x?.title || '') : []
        });
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('⚠️ [IDs] Не удалось построить отпечаток объекта:', error.message);
        return String(item?.title || '');
    }
}

/**
 * Главная точка входа.
 * 1. Явный id из JSON — всегда в приоритете.
 * 2. YouTube — id первого ролика (yt-XXXXXXXXXXX).
 * 3. Остальное — slug заголовка, либо хэш отпечатка.
 */
export function createStableId(item, prefix, used) {
    if (item && item.id !== undefined && item.id !== null && String(item.id).trim() !== '') {
        return makeUniqueId(String(item.id).trim(), used);
    }

    const firstVideo = (item && Array.isArray(item.videos)) ? item.videos[0] : null;
    const videoId = getYouTubeId(firstVideo);

    if (prefix === 'yt' && videoId) {
        return makeUniqueId(`yt-${videoId}`, used);
    }

    const slug = slugify(item && item.title);
    const base = slug ? `${prefix}-${slug}` : `${prefix}-${hashString(stableSeed(item))}`;
    return makeUniqueId(base, used);
}

/* js/utils/Typewriter.js */

export class Typewriter {
    constructor(element) {
        if (!element) throw new Error('[Typewriter] Не передан DOM-элемент');
        this.el = element;
        this.timeout = null;
        this.isStopped = false;
    }

    /**
     * Одноразовая печать текста (используется для описания отряда)
     */
    type(text, speed = 40, onComplete = null) {
        this.stop(); // Очищаем предыдущие таймеры
        this.isStopped = false;
        this.el.innerHTML = "";
        let i = 0;

        const typeChar = () => {
            if (this.isStopped) return;
            
            if (i < text.length) {
                this.el.innerHTML += text.charAt(i);
                i++;
                this.timeout = setTimeout(typeChar, speed);
            } else {
                this.el.innerHTML = this.el.innerHTML.replace('|', ''); 
                if (onComplete) onComplete();
            }
        };
        typeChar();
    }

    /**
     * Бесконечный цикл строк (используется для бегущей строки статистики)
     */
    loop(getMessagesFn, typeSpeed = 80, deleteSpeed = 30, pause = 2000) {
        this.stop();
        this.isStopped = false;
        
        let messageIndex = 0;
        let charIndex = 0;
        let isDeleting = false;

        const tick = () => {
            if (this.isStopped) return;

            // Получаем актуальный массив сообщений через функцию (чтобы реагировать на обновления Twitch)
            const messages = getMessagesFn();
            if (!messages || messages.length === 0) return;

            // Защита от выхода за пределы массива при его изменении на лету
            messageIndex = messageIndex % messages.length;
            const fullMessage = messages[messageIndex];

            // Формируем текущую строку
            let currentText = isDeleting 
                ? fullMessage.substring(0, charIndex--) 
                : fullMessage.substring(0, charIndex++);

            this.el.textContent = currentText + '|';

            let currentSpeed = isDeleting ? deleteSpeed : typeSpeed;

            // Логика смены состояний
            if (!isDeleting && charIndex === fullMessage.length + 1) {
                isDeleting = true;
                currentSpeed = pause; // Пауза перед стиранием
            } else if (isDeleting && charIndex === -1) {
                isDeleting = false;
                messageIndex = (messageIndex + 1) % messages.length;
            }

            this.timeout = setTimeout(tick, currentSpeed);
        };

        tick();
    }

    stop() {
        this.isStopped = true;
        if (this.timeout) {
            clearTimeout(this.timeout);
            this.timeout = null;
        }
    }
}
